a: Ketanna min haerusin – en osim bah maamar ella middaat aviha. vehannaara – ben middaat atzmah ben middaat aviha, (ma sheen ken bekiddushin).
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may tameh derabbi yochanan allibba derabbanan? kiddushin, demiddata – aviha vela hi. gerushin, dival kurcha – ben hi ben aviha.
Hare maamar, demiddata, vekatane: ben hi uven aviha! hatam bemaamar dival kurcha, verabbi hi. detanya: haose maamar bivimto shello middatah, rabbi omer: kana, vachachamim omrim lo kana.
May tameh derabbi? gamar mibbia divama, ma bia divama beal kurcha – af hacha name beal kurcha. verabbanan savri: yalfinan mikkiddushin, ma kiddushin demiddata – af hacha name demiddata.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi savar: mille divama mivama hava leh lemelaf. verabbanan savri: kiddushin mikkiddushin hava leh lemelaf.

Hachi name mistabbera kidka metaretz rabbi yochanan, middekatane sefa: "ma sheen ken bekiddushin". ella nema tehve teyuveta deresh lakish? amar lach resh lakish: ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: en shete yadayim zochot keachat.
I rabbi yehuda, ma sheen ken bekiddushin?! ma sheen ken begerushin mibbee leh! in hachi name, ayyeyde ditna maamar dedame lekiddushin, tena name: ma sheen ken bekiddushin.
Verabbi yehuda, may shena maamar? hoil uzekuka veomedet. hasheta deatet lehachi, rabbi yochanan name la tikshe lach meikkara: shane maamar, hoil uzekuka veomedet.
Tenan: haish mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara, bo uvishlucho. bo uvishlucho – in, bah uvishluchah – la, teyuveta deresh lakish! amar lach resh lakish: ha name rabbi yehuda hi.
Umi matzet mokmat la kerabbi yehuda? vehakatane sefa: haomer leishsha: "hitkaddeshi li bitmara zo", "hitkaddeshi li bazo" veamrinan: man tanna "hitkaddeshi" "hitkaddeshi"?
Veamar rabba: rabbi shimon hi, deamar: ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad!
Vechi tema kulla rabbi yehuda, uvifrate savar la kerabbi shimon, umi savar la?

Vehatanya: ze hakkelal: kalal – eno chayyayv ella achat, parat – chayyayv al kol achat veachat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: "shevua lo lach, lo lach, lo lach" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. rabbi eliezer omer: "lo lach, lo lach, lo lach velo lach shevua" – chayyayv al kol achat veachat. rabbi shimon omer: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad.
Ella: kulla rabbi shimon hi, uvishlichut savar la kerabbi yehuda.

Rabbi assi la al leve midresha. ashkecheh lerabbi zera, amar leh: may amur haiddana be midresha? amar leh: af ana la ayayli[10], rabbi avin hu deayel vaamar: chavruta kulla kerabbi yochanan. utzevavch resh lakish ki cherucheya: "veyatza. vehayta", velekka deashgach beh. amar leh: rabbi avin bar samcha hu? amar leh: in, kemin yamma letigne hu.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ana, la rabbi avin berabbi chiyyay, vela rabbi avin bar kahana, ella rabbi avin setam. lemay nafka minna? lemirme dideh addideh.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman:
b: Naara, mahu shettaase shaliach lekabbel gittah miyyad balah? keyad aviha damya, o kachatzar aviha damya? keyad aviha damya, ma aviyya meshavve shaliach – af hi name meshavveya shaliach. o dilma kachatzar aviha damya, vead demate gitta lida la miggarsha.

Umi mesappeka leh lerava ha? vehaamar rava: katav get unetano beyad avdah yashen umeshammarto – hare ze get. neor – eno get. neor ammay eno get – dehavya la chatzer mishtammeret shello ledatah. vei salka datach kachatzar aviha damya, ki meta gitta lida name la tiggarash, dehavya la chatzer hammishtammeret shello ledaat aviha!
Ella leolam peshita leh dechi yad aviha damya, vehachi kamibbaya leh: mi allima keyad aviha leshauoye ihi shaliach, o la? amar leh: en osa shaliach.
Etiveh: ketanna sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti" – eno get ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. ha naara – hare ze get! hacha bemay askinan – besheen la av.

Ha middekatane sefa: im amar aviha: "tze vekabbel get levitti", im ratza baal lachazor bo – lo yachzor. mikkelal deresha bidyesh lah av askinan! chassore michassera vehachi katane: ketanna sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti" – eno get, ad sheyyaggia get leyadah. ha naara – hare ze get. bamme devarim amurim – kesheen lah av, aval yesh lah av veamar aviha: "tze vekabbel levitti gittah", verotze baal lachzor – lo yachzor.
Ittemar: ketanna shennitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha, amar shemuel: tzericha get, utzericha meun. amar karna: devarim bego: im get, lamma meun? im meun, lamma get?
Amaru leh: ha mar ukeva uve dineh bechafri. afchuha, shadderuha lekammeh derav. amar lehu: haelohim! tzericha get, utzericha meun. vechas leh lezareh deabba bar abba, denema hachi.
Vetama may? amar rav acha bereh derav ika: tzericha get – shemma nitratztza haav bekiddushin, tzericha meun – shemma lo nitratztza haav bekiddushin, veyomru en kiddushin tofsin baachotah.
Amar rav nachman: vehu sheshshiddechu.
Ulla amar: afillu meun enah tzericha. af al gav deshiddechu? man dematne ha, la matne ha. ikka deamri amar ulla: ketanna shennitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha – afillu meun enah tzericha.
Metiv rav kahana: vechullan, im metu, o meanu, o nitgarshu, o shennimtzeu ayyloniyyot – tzarotehen muttarot.
Dekaddesha man? ilema dekaddesha aviha, bemeun saggi la?! get mealleya baaya! ella lav dekaddisha ihi nafsha, vekatane devaaya meun!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: kegon shennaasa lah maase yetoma bechayye haav.
Metiv rav hamenuna: en mochrah likrovim. mishshum rabbi elazar amru: mochrah likrovim.

a: Veshavin shemmochrah almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. hay almana hechi dame? illema dekaddesha aviha, mi matze mezabben la? ha en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut! ella lav dekaddish ihi nafsha veka kare la almana!
Amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak: hacha bekiddushe yiud. veallibba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda, deamar: maot harishonot lav lekiddushin nittenu.
Ittemar: met venafla lifne achiv leyibbum, amar rav huna amar rav: memaenet lemaamaro, veenah memaenet lezikkato. ketzad? asa bah maamar – tzericha get, utzericha chalitza, utzericha meun.

Tzericha get – shemma nitratztza haav bekiddushe sheni. tzericha chalitza – shemma nitratztza haav bekiddushe rishon. tzericha meun – shemma lo nitratztza haav lo bekiddushe rishon velo bekiddushe sheni, veyomru en kiddushin tofsin baachotah.

Lo asa bah maamar – enah tzericha ella chalitza bilvad. may amrat: tibbee name meun, shemma yomru en kiddushin tofsin baachotah? hakkol yodim: achot chalutza derabbanan. deamar resh lakish: kan shana rabbi achot gerusha middeorayyta, achot chalutza middivre sofrim.

Hanhu be tere dahavo ka shatu chamra tute tzippe bevavel. shekal chad minnayyhu kasa dechamra, yehav leh lechavreh. amar: mikkaddesha li berattaych livri. amar ravina: afillu leman deamar chayyshinan shemma nitratztza haav –
b: Shemma nitratztza habben la amrinan. amri leh rabbanan leravina: vedilma shaliach shavveye? la chatzif inish leshauoye laavu shaliach. vedilma artzoye artzeyay kammeh? amar leh rabba bar shimi: beferush amar mar dela savar leha derav ushemuel.
Hahu gavra dekaddesh bechisha deyarka beshuka. amar ravina: afillu leman deamar choshshin shemma nitratztza haav – hane mille derech kavod, aval derech bizzayon – la.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: bizzayon demay? i bizzayon deyarka, i bizzayon deshuka? nafka minna dekaddesh bechaspa beshuka, o bechisha deyarka beveta, may? amar leh: idde veidde derech bizzayon hu.
Hahu deamar lekarivay, vehi amra lekariva. kefatteh ad daamar la: "tehve lekariva". addeachli veshatu ata kariveh beiggara vekaddesha.
Amar abbaye: ketiv "sheerit yisrael lo yaasu avla velo yedabberu chazav". rava amar: chazaka en adam toreach bisuda umafsidah.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu dela terach.

Nitkaddesha ledaat aviha, vehalach aviha limdinat hayyam veamda venisset, amar rav: ochelet bitruma ad sheyyavo aviha vimache. rav assi amar: enah ochelet, shemma yavo aviha vimache, venimtzet zara ochelet bitruma lemafrea. hava ovada vechash la rav leha derav assi.
Amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: umode rav sheim meta – eno yorshah. oki mamona bechezkat mareh.
Nitkaddesha ledaat venisset shello ledaat, veaviha kan, rav huna amar: enah ochelet. rav yirmeya bar abba amar: ochelet.

Rav huna amar: enah ochelet. vaafillu lerav, deamar ochelet – hatam hu dela iteh leav, aval hacha deiteh leav, hay deishtik – mirtach ratach. rav yirmeya bar abba amar: ochelet. vaafillu lerav assi deamar enah ochelet, hatam hu deshemma yavo aviha vimache, aval hacha middishtek – itnoche itnecha leh.

Nitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha, venisset shello ledaat, veaviha kan, rav huna amar: ochelet, rav yirmeya bar abba amar: enah ochelet. amar ulla: ha derav huna "kachometz lashshinnayim vecheashan laenayim". hasheta uma hatam dekiddushe deorayyta amrat la achla, hacha lo kol shekken?!

a: Nirin divre talmid. amar rava: may tama derav huna – hoil venaasa bah maase yetoma bechayye haav.

Ittemar: ketanna shennitkaddesha shello ledaat aviha, amar rav: ben hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev. verav assi amar: aviha velo hi. etiveh rav huna lerav assi, veamri la chiyyay bar rav lerav assi: "im maen yemaen aviha", en li ella aviha, hi atzmah minnayin? talmud lomar: "im maen yemaen" – mikkol makom.

Amar lehu rav: la tezlu batar ippecha. yachevl leshannoye lechu: kegon sheppittah shello leshum ishut. pittah shello leshum ishut kera bae? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lomar shemmeshallem kenas kimfutta.

Amar leh rav yosef: i hachi, hayeynu ditnena: "mahor yimharenna lo leishsha" – shetztzericha hemennu kiddushin. veim pittah leshum ishut, kiddushin lema li? amar leh abbaye: tzericha kiddushin ledaat aviha.

Mishna haomer leishsha "hitkaddeshi li bitmara zo", "hitkaddeshi li bazo" im yesh beachat mehen shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. "bazo uvazo uvazo" im yesh shave peruta bechullan – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. hayta ochelet rishona rishona – enah mekuddeshet, ad sheyyehe beachat mehen shave peruta.
Gemara man tena "hitkaddeshi" "hitkaddeshi"? amar rabba: rabbi shimon hi, deamar ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad.
"Bazo uvazo uvazo" im yesh bechullan shave peruta kulei. aheyay? illema aresha, may irya ochelet? afillu minchat name, deha "hitkaddeshi li bazo" kaamar! ella assefa.
Vaafillu bekammayyta? veha milva hi! amar rabbi yochanan: hare shulchan, vahare basar, vahare sakkin, veen lanu [pe] leechol!

Rav ushemuel amri tarvayyhu: leolam aresha, vela mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya mannachat, dei ikka shave peruta – in, i la – la. aval ochelet, hoil umikkarva hanayayta, ema gamra umakneya nafsha, ka mashma lan.
Rabbi amme amar: leolam assefa, umay "ad sheyyehe beachat mehen shave peruta" – ad sheyyehe baacharona shave peruta.
Amar rava: shema minna midderabbi amme telat. shema minna: hamekaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet, ushema minna: hamekaddesh bemilva uferuta, data apperuta,
b: Ushema minna: maot bealma – chozrim.

Ittemar: hamekaddesh achoto, rav amar: maot chozrim. ushemuel amar: maot mattana. rav amar: maot chozrim – adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin baachoto, vegamar venatan leshum pikkadon. velema la leshum pikkadon! savar la mekabbela.
Ushemuel savar: maot mattana – adam yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin baachoto, vegamar venatan leshum mattana. venema la leshum mattana! savar: kesifa la milleta.
Metiv ravina: hammafrish challato kemach – enah challa, vegazel beyad kohen. veammay gazel beyad kohen? nema: adam yodea sheen mafrishim challa kemach, venatan leshem mattana!
Shane hatam, denafek chureba minna – zimnin deit leh lechohen pachot mechamesh revaim kemach, vehay alesh leh bahade hadade, vekasavar nittakkena issato, veate lemechla betivla.
Vehaamrat: adam yodea sheen mafrishim challa kemach! yodea veeno yodea. yodea sheen mafrish challa kemach, veeno yodea, desavar: tamayyhu may – mishshum tircha dechohen vetircha dechohen achelteh.
Vetihve teruma, velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha challa mimmakom acher. mi la tenan: min hannakuv al sheeno nakuv – teruma, velo teachel ad sheyyotzi aleha teruma umaaser mimmakom acher?
Bitre mane – tzaet, bechad mana – la tzaet.
Veibbaet ema: leolam kohen metzat tzayet, vekasavar baal habbayit nittakkena issato, veate lemechal betivla.
Vehaamrat: adam yodea sheen mafrishin challa kemach! yodea veeno yodea. yodea sheen mafrishin challa kemach, veeno yodea, desavar tama may – mishshum tircha dechohen, tircha dechohen kabbela aleh.
Vetihve teruma, veyachzor veyitrom. mi la tenan: mishsheeno nakuv al hannakuv – teruma, veyachzor veyitrom! ha okemna: bitre mane tzaet, bechad mana la tzaet.
Vela tzaet?! vehatnan: hattorem kishshut venimtza mara, avattiach venimtzet saruach – teruma, veyachazor veyitrom! shane hatam, demiddeorayyta teruma mealleya hi,

Midderabbi ilay. deamar rabbi ilay: minnayin lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma? shenneemar: "velo tisu alav chet baharimchem et chelbo" – im eno kadosh, nesiut chet lamma? mikkan lattorem min haraa al hayyafa shetterumato teruma.
Amar rava:

a: Lo shanu ella deamar lah: "bazo uvazo uvazo". aval amar lah: "beellu" – afillu ochelet name mekuddeshet, ki ka achla – middenafsha kaachla.

Tanya kevateh derava: "hitkaddeshi li beallon berimmon uveegoz" o sheamar lah: "hitkaddeshi li beellu", im yesh bechullan shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. "bazo uvazo uvazo", im yesh bechullam shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. "bazo" – netalattu vaachalattu, "bazo" – netalattu vaachalattu, veod "bazo" veod "bazo" – enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyehe beachat mehen shave peruta.

Hay "beallon berimmon beegoz", hechi dame? ilema deamar la: "o beallon, o berimmon, o beegoz", im yesh bechullan shave peruta mekuddeshet? veha "o" kaamar! veella "beallon uverimmon uveegoz" – hayeynu "bazo uvazo uvazo"! ella lav daamar la: "beellu", ha middekatane sefa: o sheamar lah "hitkaddeshi li beellu" – mikkelal deresha lav beellu" askinan.
Payrushe ka mefaresh: "hitkaddeshi li beallon berimmon beegoz", ketzad? kegon deamar la "hitkaddeshi li beellu".
Vekatane sefa "bazo" netalattu vaachalattu, im yesh beachat mehem shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet.
Veillu resha, la ka mefalleg ben ochelet lemannachat. shema minna: kol hecha daamar la "beellu" ki ka achla – minnafsha ka achla, shema minna.
Hanicha leman deamar assefa kae, umay "ad sheyyehe beachat mehen shave peruta" – ad sheyyehe baacharona shave peruta, hachi name: ad sheyyehe baacharona shave peruta.
Ella lerav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: aresha kae, veochelet itztericha leh – hacha kelale kachashev, perate la ka chashev.
Ha manni – rabbi hi, daamar: la shena "kezayit kezayit", vela shena "kezayit uchezayit", perata have.

Amar rav: hamekaddesh bemilve – enah mekuddeshet, milva lehotzaa nittena. nema ketannae: hamekaddesh bemilve – enah mekuddeshet, veyesh omrim: mekuddeshet. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar milva lehotzaa nittena, umar savar milva lav lehotzaa nittena?
Vetisbera?! ema sefa: veshavim bemecher shezze kana. i amrat milva lehotzaa nittena, bemay kane?!

Amar rav nachman: huna chavrin mokem la bemille uchere, vehacha bemay askinan — kegon sheamar la: "hitkaddeshi li bemane" venimtza mane chaser dinar. mar savar: kesifa la milleta lemitbeeh. umar savar: la kesifa la milleta lemitbeeh.

Veella ha deamar rabbi elazar: "hitkaddeshi li bemane" venatan lah dinar – hare zo mekuddeshet veyashlim, lema ketannae amra lishmateh? amri: mane chaser dinar kesifa la milleta lemitbeeh, mane chaser tishim vatesha la kesifa la milleta lemitbeeh.

Metivi: haomer leishsha "hitkaddeshi li befikkadon sheyyesh li beyadech" vehalcha umetzaattu shennignav o sheavad, im nishtayyer hemennu shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. uvemilva, af al pi shello nishtayyer hemennu shave peruta – mekuddeshet. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: milva
b: Hare hi kefikkadon. ad kan la peligi ella demar savar: milva, af al gav delo nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta, umar savar: nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta – in, vei la nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta – la. aval dechulle alma mekaddesh bemilva mekuddeshet!
Amar leh rava: vetisbera ha metaratzta? ha meshabbashta hi.

Hay pikkadon hechi dame? i dekabbil alay achrayut, hayeynu milva. i dela kabbil alay achrayut – i hachi addetane sefa: uvemilva, af al pi shello nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta – mekuddeshet, niflog venitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim – shello kibbela aleha achrayut, aval kibbela aleha achrayut, af al gav delo nishtayyer hemenna shave peruta mekuddeshet!
Ella, taretz hachi: uvemilva, af al pi shennishtayyer hemenna shave peruta – enah mekuddeshet.

Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir: milva hare hi kefikkadon. bemay kamippalgi? amar rabba: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan beve rav deyatvi vekaamri: bemilva birshut bealim lachazara vehu haddin leunesin kamippalgi,
Demar savar: milva birshut love kayyma, vehu haddin laonasim. umar savar: milva birshut bealim kayyma, vehu haddin laonasim.

Veamena lehu: laonasim – kulle alma la peligi devirshut love kayymi, may tama – la gara mishsheela, ma sheela dehadra beena chayyayv baonasim, milva lo kol shekken. ella hacha milva birshut bealim lachazara ikka benayyhu.
Veella ha deamar rav huna: hashshoel kuredom mechavero, bikka bo – kenao. lo bikka bo – lo kenao. lema ketannae amra lishmateh?
La, ad kan la peligi ella bemilva, dela hadra beena. aval bishela, dehadra beena, divre hakkol bikka bo – in, lo bikka bo – lo kenao.

Nema ketannae? "hitkaddeshi li bishtar chov", o shehaya lo milva beyad acherim vehirshah alehem, rabbi meir omer: mekuddeshet, vachachamim omrim: enah mekuddeshet. hay shetar chov hechi dame? illema shetar chov daacherim – hayeynu milva beyad acherim! ella lav shetar chov dida, uvimkaddesh bemilva kamippalgi?
Leolam shetar chov daacherim, vehacha bemilva bishtar uvemilva al pe ka mippalgi.

Bemilva bishtar bemay peligi – biflugeta derabbi verabbanan kamippalgi. detanya: otiyyot niknot bimsira, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: ben shekkatav velo masar, ben shemmasar vela katav – lo kana ad sheyyichtov veyimsor.
Mar it leh derabbi umar let leh derabbi.

Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma let lehu derabbi, vehacha bidrav pappa kamippalgi, deamar rav pappa: hay man dezaven shetara lechavreh, tzarich lemichtav leh: "keni lach hu vechol shibudeh". mar it leh derav pappa, umar let leh derav pappa.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma it lehu derav pappa vehacha bedishmuel kamippalgi. deamar shemuel:

a: Hammocher shetar chov lachavero, vechazar umechalo – machul, vaafillu yoresh mochel. demar it leh dishmuel. umar let leh dishmuel.

Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel, vehacha beishsha kamippalgi. mar savar: ishsha samcha data, memar amra: la shavek leh ledidi umachel leh leacharine, umar savar: ishsha name la samcha data
Bemilva al pe. bemay peligi? bidrav huna amar rav, deamar rav huna amar rav: mane li beyadcha, tenehu lifloni bemaamad shelashtan – kana.
Mar savar: ki kaamar rav hane mille befikkadon, aval milva – la. umar savar: la shena milva vela shena pikkadon.

Nema ketannae: "hitkaddeshi li bishtar" – rabbi meir omer: enah mekuddeshet, verabbi elazar omer: mekuddeshet, vachachamim omrim: shamin et hanneyayr, im yesh bo shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet.
Hay shetar hechi dame? illema shetar chov daacherim – kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir. ella bishtar chov dida, uvimkaddesh bemilva ka mippalgi!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, hacha bemay askinan kegon shekkiddeshah bishtar sheen alav edim.

Verabbi meir letameh deamar: ede chatima karti, verabbi elazar letameh deamar: ede mesira karti, verabbanan mesappeka lehu i kerabbi meir i kerabbi elazar, hilkach shamin et hanneyayr, im yesh bo shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav enah mekuddeshet.

Veibbaet ema, kegon shekketavo shello lishmah, uvidresh lakish kamippalgi. devae resh lakish: shetar erusin shekketavo shello lishmah, mahu? havaya litzia makkeshinan, ma yetzia baenan lishmah, af havaya name baenan lishmah. o dilma: havayot lahadade makkeshinan, ma havaya dechesef la baenan lishmah, af havaya dishtar la baenan lishmah.
Batar devaya hadar pashta: "veyatza... vehayta", makkish havaya litzia. mar it leh deresh lakish, umar let leh deresh lakish.

Vei baet ema: dechulle alma it lehu deresh lakish, vehacha bemay askinan, shekketavo lishmah veshello middatah. uviflugeta derava veravina, verav pappa verav sherevya kamippalgi. deittemar: ketavo lishmah veshello middatah, rava veravina amri: mekuddeshet, rav pappa verav sherevya amri: enah mekuddeshet.
Nema kehane tannae, detanya: "ase li shirim nezamim vetabbaot, veekkaddesh ani lach", kevan sheasaan – mekuddeshet, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim omrim: enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyaggia mamon leyadah.
Hay mamon hechi dame? illema oto mamon, mikkelal detanna kamma savar: afillu oto mamon name la! ella bemay ku mikkaddesha? ella lav bemamon acher, ushema minna bimkaddesh bemilva kamippalgi.
Vesavri dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechilla [vead] sof vehave milva. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: hamekaddesh bemilva mekuddeshet, umar savar: hamekaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet?
La, dechulle alma mekaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet, vehacha – beyeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof kamippalgi, mar savar:
b: Enah lischirut ella bassof. umar savar: yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof.

Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof, umekaddesh bemilva – enah mekuddeshet, vehacha, beumman kona bishvach keli kamippalgi. mar savar: umman kona bishvach keli, umar savar: en umman kone bishvach keli.

Vei baet ema: dechulle alma en umman kona bishvach keli, veyeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof, umekaddesh bemilva enah mekuddeshet, vehacha bemay askinan – kegon shehosif lah nofech mishshello. demar savar: milva uferuta, dateh apperuta, umar savar: dateh ammilva.

Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: "bischar sheasiti immach" – enah mekuddeshet. "bischar sheeese immach" – mekuddeshet. rabbi natan omer: "bischar sheeese immach" – enah mekuddeshet, vechol shekken "bischar sheasiti immach".
Rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: beemet amru: ben "bischar sheasiti", ben "bischar sheeese immach" – enah mekuddeshet. veim hosif lah nofech mishshello – mekuddeshet.
Ben tanna kamma lerabbi natan – ikka benayyhu sechirut, ben rabbi natan lerabbi yehuda hannasi – ikka benayyhu milva uferuta. mar savar: milva uferuta, dateh ammilva, umar savar: dateh apperuta.

Mishna "hitkaddeshi li bechos ze shel yayin" venimtza shel devash, "shel devash" venimtza shel yayin, "bedinar ze shel kesef" venimtza shel zahav, "shel zahav" venimtza shel kesef, "al menat sheani ashir" venimtza ani, "ani" venimtza ashir – enah mekuddeshet. rabbi shimon omer: im hitah leshevach, mekuddeshet.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "hitkaddeshi li bechos ze", tane chada: bo uvamme shebbetocho, vetanya iddach: bo velo bamme shebbetocho. vetanya iddach: bamme shebbetocho velo bo. vela kashya: ha – bemayya, ha – bechamra, ha – betzihara.

Im hitah leshevach hare zo mekuddeshet. velet leh lerabbi shimon yayin venimtza chometz, chometz venimtza yayin – shenehem yecholin lachazor bahem. alma, ikka denicha leh bechalla veikka denicha leh bechamra. hacha name: ikka nicha leh bechaspa vela nicha leh bedahava!

Amar rav shimi bar ashe: ashkachteh leabbaye deyatev vekamasbar leh livreh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheamar lishlucho: "haleveni dinar shel kesef, velech vekaddesh li ishsha pelonit" vehalach vehilva shel zahav. mar savar: kefeda. umar savar: mare makom hu lo.
I hachi "hitkaddeshi li"? "hitkaddeshi lo" mibbee leh! hitah leshevach? hitahu leshevach mibbee leh! "nimtza" meikkara name dezahav hava!

Ella amar rava: ani vaari shebbachavura (targemna) [targemnuha] umannu – rabbi chiyyay bar avin, hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheamra hi lishluchah "tze vekabbel li kiddushay mippeloni sheamar li hitkaddeshi li bedinar shel kesef" vehalach venatan lo dinar shel zahav, mar savar: kefeda, umar savar: mare makom hi lo, umay "nimtza" – deka tzayir bivlita.
Amar abbaye: rabbi shimon verabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi elazar kullehu sevira lehu mare makom hu lo. rabbi shimon – ha daamaran, rabban shimon ben gamliel – ditnan:

a: Get pashut, edav mittocho. mekushshar, edav meachorav. pashut shekkatvu edav meachorav, umekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho – shenehem pesulim. rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: mekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho – kasher, sheyyachol laasoto pashut. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hakkol keminhag hammedina.

Vehavenan ba: vetanna kamma let leh minhag hammedina? veamar rav ashe: beatra dinhigi befashut vaavad leh mekushshar, i name: beatra dinhigi bimkushshar vaavad leh pashut – kulle alma la peligi devadday kefida.
Ki peligi, beatra dinhigi ben befashut ben bimkushshar, vaamar leh: "aved li pashut", vaazal vaavad leh mekushshar. mar savar: kefeda, umar savar: mare makom hu lo.
Rabbi elazar – ditnan: haishsha sheamra: "hitkabbel li gitti mimmakom peloni", vekibbel lah gittah mimmakom acher – pasul, verabbi elazar machshir. alma kasavar: mara makom hi lo.

Amar ulla: machaloket beshevach mamon, aval beshevach yuchasin, divre hakkol – enah mekuddeshet. may tama – "mesana derav mikkaray la baena". tanya name hachi: mode rabbi shimon, im hitah lishvach yuchasim enah mekuddeshet.
Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka. dekatane: "al menat sheani kohen" venimtza levi, "levi" venimtza kohen, natin venimtza mamzer, "mamzer" venimtza natin. vela pelig rabbi shimon.
Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: ella dekatane: "al menat sheyyesh li bat o shifcha meguddelet" veen lo, al menat sheen lo veyesh lo, dishvach mamon hu, hachi name dela pelig?!
Ella pelig beresha vehu haddin lesefa. hacha name pelig beresha vehu haddin lesefa.
Hachi hasheta? hatam, idde veidde dishvach mamon, pelig beresha vehu haddin besefa. hacha, dishvach yuchasim hu, im ita diflig, nitne!
Ibbaet ema: hacha name shevach yuchasim, mi savrat may meguddelet – gedola mammash? may meguddelet – gaddelet, deamra hi: la nicha li deshakla mille minnay veazla nadya kamme shivavotayy.

Tanu rabbanan: "al menat sheani karyayna", kevan shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset – hare zo mekuddeshet. rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyyikra vitargem. yetargem middateh?! vehatanya rabbi yehuda omer: hametargem pasuk ketzurato – hare ze badday. vehammosif alav – hare ze mecharef umegaddef. ella may targum – targum didan.
Vehane mille daamar la: "karyayna", aval amar la: "kara ana" – ad dekare orayyta nevie uchetuve bediyyuka.
"Al menat sheani shone", chizkiyya amar: halachot, verabbi yochanan amar: tora.
Metivi: ezo hi mishna? rabbi meir omer: halachot, rabbi yehuda omer: midrash!
b: May tora – midrash tora. vehane mille daamar la: "tanena", aval amar la: "tanna ana", ad detane hilcheta, sifra, vesifre, vetosefta.

"Al menat sheani talmid" – en omrim keshimon ben azzay ucheshimon ben zoma, ella, kol sheshshoalin oto bechol makom davar echad betalmudo veomro, vaafillu bemassechta dechalla. "al menat sheani chacham" – en omrim kechachme yavne, kerabbi akiva vachaverav, ella, kol sheshshoalim oto devar chochma bechol makom veomrah.

"Al menat sheani gibbor" – en omrim keavner ben ner ucheyoav ben tzeruya, ella kol shechaverav mityarim mimmennu mippene gevurato. "al menat sheani ashir" – en omrim kerabbi elazar ben charsom ucherabbi elazar ben azarya, ella kol shebbene iro mechabbedim oto mippene oshro.
"Al menat sheani tzaddik" – afillu rasha gamur – mekuddeshet, shemma hirher teshuva bedato. "al menat sheani rasha" – afillu tzaddik gamur – mekuddeshet, shemma hirher devar avoda zara bedato.

Asara kabbim chochma yardu laolam, tisha natla eretz yisrael veechad kol haolam kullo. asara kabbim yofi yardu laolam, tisha natla yerushalayim veechad kol haolam kullo. asara kabbim ashirut yardu laolam, tisha natla romi veechad kol haolam kullo. asara kabbim aniyyut yardu laolam, tisha natla bavel veechad kol haolam kullo. asara kabbim gassut yardu laolam, tisha natla elam veechad kol haolam kullo.

Vegassut levavel la nechit? vehachtiv: "vaessa enay vaere vehinne shetayim nashim yotzot veruach bechanfehem velahenna chenafayim kechanfe hachasida vetishne et haefa ben haaretz uven hashshamayim. vaomar el hammalach haddover bi ana hemma molichot et haefa. vayyomer elay livnot la vayit beeretz shinar". veamar rabbi yochanan: zo chanuppa vegassut haruach sheyyardu levavel!
In, lehacha nechit, veishtarbove hu deishtarbuv lehatam. dayka name dekatane: "livnot lah bayit", shema minna.

Ini?! vehaamar mar: siman legassut – aniyyut, vaaniyyut bevavel hu deikka! may aniyyut – aniyyut detora. dichtiv: "achot lanu ketanna veshadayim en lah", veamar rabbi yochanan: zo elam, shezzachta lilmod, velo zachta lelammed.

Asara kabbim gevura yardu laolam, tisha natlu parsiyyim vechulei. asara kabbim kinnim yardu laolam, tisha natla maday kulei. asara kabbim keshafim yardu laolam tisha natla mitzrayim kulei. asara kabbim negaim yardu laolam, tisha natlu chazirim kulei. asara kabbim zenut yardu laolam, tisha natla arviyya kulei.

Asara kabbim azzut yardu laolam, tisha natla meshan kulei. asara kabbim sicha yardu laolam, tisha natlu nashim kulei. asara kabbim shichrut yardu laolam, tisha natlu kushim kulei. asara kabbim shena yardu laolam, tisha natlu avadim veechad natlu kol haolam kullo.

Mishna "al menat sheani kohen" venimtza levi, "levi" venimtza kohen, "natin" venimtza mamzer. "mamzer" venimtza natin, "ben ir" venimtza ben kerach, "ben kerach" venimtza ben ir. "al menat shebbeti karov lammerchatz" venimtza rachok, "rachok" venimtza karov.

"Al menat sheyyesh lo bat o shifcha meguddelet" veen lo, o "al menat sheen lo" veyesh lo. "al menat sheen lo banim" veyesh lo, o al menat sheyyesh lo veen lo. uvechullam, af al pi sheamra: "belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo" – af al pi chen enah mekuddeshet. vechen hi shehitattu.

Gemara hahu gavra dezabben lenichseh addata lemissak leeretz yisrael, uveiddana dezabben la amar vela midde. amar rava: have devarim shebballev, udevarim shebballev enam devarim. mena leh lerava ha? illema meha ditnan:

a: "Yakriv oto" – melammed shekkofin oto. yachol beal korcho – talmud lomar: "lirtzono".

Ha ketzad? – kofin oto ad sheyyomar: "rotze ani". veammay? ha belibbeh la nicha leh! ella lav mishshum deamrinan: devarim shebballev enan devarim? vedilma shane hatam, daanan sahadi denicha leh bechappara.

Ella missefa: vechen atta motze begitte nashim veshichrure avadim, kofin oto ad sheyyomar: "rotze ani". veammay? ha belibbeh la nicha leh! ella lav mishshum deamrinan devarim shebballev enan devarim? vedilma shane hatam, mishshum demitzva lishmoa divre chachamim.

Ella amar rav yosef, mehacha: hamekaddesh et haishsha veamar: kesavur hayiti shehi kohenet vahare hi leviyya, leviyya venimtzet kohenet, aniyyay vahare hi ashira, ashira vahare hi aniyyay – mekuddeshet, mippene shello hitattu. veammay? ha kaamar kesavur hayiti! ella mishshum deamrinan devarim shebballev enan devarim. amar leh abbaye: dilma shane hatam, dilchumera.

Ella amar abbaye, mehacha: bechullam, af al pi sheamra "belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo" – af al pi chen enah mekuddeshet. veammay? ha kaamra "belibbi haya"! vedilma shane hatam, dechevan deatni lav kol keminna deakra le litnaeh.

Ella amar rav chiyyay bar avin: ovada hava be rav chisda, verav chisda be rav huna, ufashtuha meha: haomer lishlucho: "have li min hachallon o min haddeloskama", vehevi lo. af al pi sheamar baal habbayit: "lo haya li belibbi ella al ze", kevan shehevi lo mizze – baal habbayit maal. veammay? ha kaamar "belibbi"! ella lav mishshum deamrinan devarim shebballev enan devarim?
Vedilma shane hatam, dilmiftar nafsheh mikkorban kaate.
Hava leh lememar mezid hava! la avid inish dimshavve nafsheh rashshia.
Hava leh lomar "nizkarti", ditnan: nizkar baal habbayit, velo nizkar shaliach – shaliach maal.

Hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh addata lemissak leara deyisrael. selek vela ittedar leh. amar rava: kol desalek – addata lemedar hu, veha la ittedar leh. ikka deamri: addata lemissak, veha selek leh.
Hahu gavra dezabbeninhu lenichseh addata lemissak leeretz yisrael, lesof la selek. amar rav ashe: i bae, salek. ikka deamri: i bae, la salek? may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu, deityelid unesa beorcha.

Mishna haomer lishlucho: "tze vekaddesh li ishsha pelonit bemakom peloni" vehalach vekiddeshah bemakom acher – enah mekuddeshet. "hare hi bemakom peloni" vekiddeshah bemakom acher – hare zo mekuddeshet.
Gemara utenan name gabbe gittin: haomer "tenu get ze leishti bemakom peloni" unetano lah bemakom acher – pasul, "hare hi bemakom peloni" unetano lah bemakom acher – kasher.

Utzericha. dei ashmeinan gabbe kiddushin – mishshum dilkarova kaate, behay atra rachamu li vela memal[li]10 mille illavay, behay atra sanu li memal[li]10 mille illavay. aval gabbe gittin, dilrachoka kaate, emar la ichpat leh.
Vei ashmoinan gabbe gerushin, behay atra nicha leh denibbazze, behay atra la nicha leh, aval gabbe kiddushin – ema la ichpat leh, tzericha.
Mishna hamekaddesh et haishsha al menat sheen aleha nedarim, venimtzeu aleha nedarim – enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu aleha nedarim – tetze shello bichtubba.
Al menat sheen aleha mumin venimtzeu bah mumin – enah mekuddeshet. kenasah setam venimtzeu bah mumin – tetze shello bichtubba. shekkol hammumin happoslin bakkohanim poslin bannashim.
Gemara utenan name gabbe chetubbot ki hay gavvna! hacha, kiddushin itztericha leh, tena ketubbot attu kiddushin, hatam, ketubbot itztericha leh, tena kiddushin attu ketubbot.
Mishna hamekaddesh shete nashim beshave peruta, o ishsha achat befachot mishshave peruta, af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikkan
b: Enah mekuddeshet, shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shalach. vechen katan shekkiddesh.

Gemara utzericha, dei ashmeinan shave peruta, ayyeyde deka nafek mamona minneh – tae, aval pachot mishshave peruta, ema yodea sheen kiddushin tofsin befachot mishshave peruta vechi ka meshaddar sivlonot – addata dekiddushin ka meshaddar.

Vei ashmeinan hane tarte, mishshum deven peruta lefachot mishshave peruta la kim lehu leinashe. aval katan shekkiddesh – hakkol yodin sheen kiddushe katan kelum, ema: ki ka meshaddar sivlonot addata dekiddushe ka meshaddar, ka mashma lan.

Ittemar: rav huna amar: choshshin lesivlonot. vechen amar rabba: choshshin lesivlonot. amar rabba: umotvinan ashshematin: af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikkan – enah mekuddeshet! amar leh abbaye: hatam kidkatane tama: shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shalach.
Ikka deamri: amar rabba: mena amena la, kidkatane tama: shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shalach. hacha hu detae. ha bealma havu kiddushin.
Veabbaye: "la mibbaya" kaamar. la mibbaya bealma, dela nechet letorat kiddushin kelal, ella afillu hacha, dinchet letorat kiddushin ema: havu kiddushin, ka mashma lan.
May have ala? amar rav pappa: beatra dimkaddeshi vahadar mesabbeli – chayyshinan, mesabbeli vahadar mekaddeshi – la chayyshinan.
Mikkodshe vahadar mesabbeli – peshita! la tzericha, derubba mekaddeshi vahadar mesabbeli, umiuta mesabbeli vahadar mekaddeshi. mahu detema: nechush lemiuta, ka mashma lan.

Bea minneh rav acha bar rav huna merava: huchezak shetar ketubba bashshuk, mahu? amar leh: vechi mippene (shemmachzik) [shehuchezak] shetar ketubba bashshuk nachzik bah keeshet ish? may have ala? amar rav ashe: beatra dimkaddeshi vahadar katvi ketubba – chayyshinan, katvi vahadar mekaddeshi – la chayyshinan.
Mekaddeshi vahadar katvi – peshita! la tzericha, dela shechiach safra. mahu detema safra hu deitremi, ka mashma lan.

Mishna hamekaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah keachat – enan mekuddashot. umaase bechamesh nashim uvahen shete achayot, velikket adam echad kalkalla shel teenim. veshellahen hayta, veshel sheviit hayta, veamar: "hare kullechem mekuddashot li bechalkalla zo", vekibbela achat mehen al yede kullan. veamru chachamim: en achayot mekuddashot.

Gemara menahane mille? amar rame bar chama: deamar kera: "ishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror", hattora amra: beshaa shennaasu tzarot zo lazo, lo yehe lo likkuchim afillu beachat mehem. amar leh rava: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv "venichretu hannefashot haosot mikkerev ammam" – i kiddushin la tafsi ba, karet mi michayyayv?
Ella amar rava: kera beze achar ze, umatnitin kidrabba. deamar rabba: kol sheeno beze achar ze afillu bevat achat eno.
Gufa. amar rabba: kol sheeno beze achar ze afillu bevat achat eno. etiveh abbaye:

a: Hammarbe bammaaser – perotav metukkanim umaserotav mekulekalin. veammay? nema: kol sheeno beze achar ze afillu bevat achat eno.
Amar leh: shane maaser, deiteh lachatzaim, dei amar: "tikdosh palga dechitteta" – kadsha.
Vahare masar behema, delekka lachatzain, velekka beze achar ze. veamar rava: yatzu shenayim baasiri, ukeraan "asiri" – asiri veachad asar meoravim ze baze.
Shane masar behema, deiteh betaut. ditnan: kara latteshii "asiri", velaasiri "teshii", velaachad asar "asiri" – shelashtan mekuddashin.

Hare toda, deleta betaut, veleta name beze achar ze, veittemar: toda shennishchata al shemonim challot, chizkiyya amar: kadshi la arbaim mittoch shemonim. verabbi yochanan amar: la kadshi la arbaim mittoch shemonim.
Lav ittemar ala, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hakkol modim kol hecha deamar: "kadshi la arbaim mittoch shemonim" – kadshi, "lo yikdeshu arbaim ella im ken kadshi shemonim" – la kadshi.
Lo nechleku ella bistam, mar savar: leachrayut ka mikkavvavn. umar savar: lekorban gadol ka mikkavvavn.
Verava, lema leh leshannoye kerabba? tippok leh kiddushin sheen mesurin levia ninhu.
Lidvarav derame bar chama kaamar.

Ittemar: kiddushin sheen mesurin levia, abbaye amar: havu kiddushin. rava amar: la havu kiddushin. amar rava: bar ahina asbera li: "ki yikkach ish ishsha uvealah", kiddushin hamesurin levia – havu kiddushin, kiddushin sheen mesurin levia – la havu kiddushin.

Tenan: hamekaddesh ishsha uvittah o ishsha vaachotah keachat – enan mekuddashot. ha achat meishsha uvittah o meishsha vaachotah – mekuddeshet. veammay? kiddushin sheen mesurin levia ninhu! teyuveta derava!

Amar lach rava: uletamaych, ema sefa: maase bechamesh nashim uvahen shete achayot, velikket echad kalkalla shel teenim, veshellahen hayta, veshel sheviit hayta, veamar: "hare kullechem mekuddashot li bechalkalla zo". veamru chachamim: en achayot mekuddashot. achayot hu deenan mekuddashot, ha nachriyyot – mekuddashot.
Hechi dame? ilema deamar "kullechem" – "keni at vachamor" hu, veat vachamor" lo kana.
b: Ella lav daamar lehu: "achat mikkem" vekatane: en achayot mekuddashot? lerava kashya resha, leabbaye kashya sefa. abbaye metaretz letameh, rava metaretz letameh.
Abbaye metaretz letameh: hamekaddesh ishsha uvittah, o ishsha vaachotah keachat – enan mekuddashot. ha achat meishsha uvittah, meishsha vaachotah – mekuddeshet.

Veim amar: "haruya levia titkaddesh li" – enah mekuddeshet. umaase name bechamesh nashim uvahen shete achayot, velikket echad kalkalla shel teenim veamar: "haruya li mikkem titkaddesh li", veamru chachamim: en achayot mekuddashot.

Verava metaretz letameh: hamekaddesh achat meishsha uvittah o achat meishsha vaachotah – naasa kemi shekkiddesh ishsha uvittah, o ishsha vaachotah keachat, veenan mekuddashot. umaase name bechamesh nashim uvahem shete achayot, velikket echad kalkalla shel teenim veamar: hare kullechem veachat mishte achayot mekuddashot li bechalkalla zo, veamru chachamim: en achayot mekuddashot.
Ta shema: hamekaddesh et bitto setam – en habbogrot bakkelal. ha ketannot bakkelal. veammay? kiddushin sheen mesurin levia ninhu, uteyuveta derava!
Amar lach rava: hacha bemay askinan, kesheen sham ella gedola uketanna.
Ha bogrot katane! may bogrot – bogrot dealma. i hachi may lememra?
Hacha bemay askinan, deshavviteh shaliach. mahu detema ki mekabbel kiddushe – addata dida ka mekabbel, ka mashma lan dela shavek inish midde deit leh hanaa minneh.
Mi la askinan deamra leh "kiddushay ledidach"? afillu hachi, la shavek inish mitzva deramya aleh veaved mitzva dela ramya aleh.

Ta shema: mi sheyyesh lo shete kitte vanot mishte nashim, veamar: "kiddashti et bitti haggedola, veeni yodea im gedola shebbaggedolot veim gedola shebbakketannot, im ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot" – kullan asurot, chutz mikketanna shebbakketannot, divre rabbi meir.
Hacha bemay askinan, keshehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu. dayka name dekatane: "eni yodea", vela katane "en yadua", shema minna.
I hachi may lememra? leappoke midderabbi yose, deamar: la machet inish nafsheh lisfeka. ka mashma lan demachet inish nafsheh lisfeka.

Ta shema: mi shekkiddesh achat mishte achayot veeno yodea ezo kiddesh – noten get lazo veget lazo. hacha bemay askinan, keshehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu. dayka name, dekatane: "eno yodea", vela katane: "eno yadua".
I hachi may lememra? sefa itztericha leh: met velo ach echad, choletz lishtehen. hayu lo shenayim – echad choletz veechad meyaybem. im kadmu vechansu, en motziin otam miyyadam.
Davka michlatz vahadar yabbome, aval yabbome vahadar michlatz – la, deka paga baachot zekukato.

Ta shema: shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot, ze eno yodea ezo kiddesh veze eno yodea ezo kiddesh – ze noten shene gittin, veze noten shene gittin! hacha name, shehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu. dayka name dekatane: "eno yodea", vela katane: "en yadua", shema minna.
I hachi, may lememra? sefa itztericha leh: met, velaze ach velaze ach – ze choletz lishtehen veze choletz lishtehen. laze echad velaze shenayim –

a: Haechad choletz lishtehen, vehashshenayim – echad choletz veechad meyabbem. im kadmu vechansu – en motziin otan miyyadam.
Davka michlatz vahadar yabbome, aval yabbome vahadar michlatz – la, deka paga bivama lashshuk.

Ta shema, detane tavyome: leze chamishsha banim uleze chamishsha banot, veamar: "achat mibbenotecha mekuddeshet leechad mibbanay" – kol achat veachat tzericha chamishsha gittin. met echad mehem – kol achat veachat tzericha arbaa gittin, vachalitza meechad mehen.
Vechi tema: hachi name keshehukkeru ulevassof nitarvu, ha "achat mibbenotecha leechad mibbanay" katane, teyuveta derava, teyuveta. vehilcheta kevoteh deabbaye beyaal kagam.
Maase bechamesh nashim. amar rav: shema minna mimmatnitin arba, venaket rav bideh telat.

Shema minna: hamekaddesh beferot sheviit – mekuddeshet, ushema minna: kiddeshah begazel – enah mekuddeshet, afillu begazel dida. mimmay? middekatane: shellahem hayta veshel sheviit hayta – tama dishviit, dehefker hu, ha dishar shene shavua – la.
Ushema minna: ishsha naaset shaliach lachavertah, vaafillu bimkom shennaaset lah tzara.
Veiddach may hi? kiddushin sheen mesurim levia. venichsheva! mishshum dimsappeka leh i keabbaye i kerava.

Ki selek rabbi zera amra leha shemata kammeh derabbi yochanan. amar leh: mi amar rav hachi? vehu la amar?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: gazal velo nityayashu habbealim – shenehem enam yecholim lehakedish, ze lefi sheeno shello, veze lefi sheeno birshuto. hachi kaamar leh: mi amar rav kevoti?
Metivi: kiddeshah begazel, bechamas, uvigneva, o shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah – mekuddeshet! hatam begazel dida.

Ha middekatane sefa: o shechataf sela mishshellah – mikkelal deresha begazel dealma askinan! payrushe ka mefaresh: kiddeshah begazel, bechamas, uvigneva ketzad? kegon shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah bo.
b: Veha matnitin, degazel dida, vekaamar rav: enah mekuddeshet! la kashya: ha – deshaddech, ha – dela shaddech.

Hahi itteta dahava ka mashya kara bimshichla demayya, ata hahu gavra, chataf zuze mechavreh usheda la. amar la: mikkaddeshat li. ata hahu gavra lekammeh derava. amar: let dechash leha derabbi shimon, deamar: setam gezela – yeush bealim have.
Hahu arisa dekaddesh bemoza deshamche, ata lekammeh derava. amar leh: man achalach? vehane mille bemoza, aval kisha, matze amar leh: ana shekali kisha, shekel at kisha, kisha ki chisha.
Hahu serasya dekaddesh bifruma deshichra. ata mareh deshichra ashkecheh. amar leh: ammay la tittev mehay charifa? ata lekammeh derava. amar: lo amru "kelach etzel yafot", ella leinyan teruma bilvad.

Detanya: ketzad amru: torem shello middaat terumato teruma? hare sheyyarad letoch sede chavero velikket vetaram shello birshut, im choshesh mishshum gazel – en terumato teruma, veim lav – terumato teruma.

Uminnayin haya yodea im choshesh mishshum gazel im lav? hare shebba baal habbayit umetzao veamar lo: "kelach etzel yafot" im nimtzeu yafot mehem – terumato teruma, veim lav – en terumato teruma. hayu habbealim melakketim umosifim, ben kach uven kach – terumato teruma.
Aval hacha, mishshum kissufa hu daavad, veenah mekuddeshet.

Mishna hamekaddesh bechelko, ben kodshe kodashim, ben kodashim kallim – enah mekuddeshet. bemaaser sheni, ben shogeg ben mezid – lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg – lo kiddesh, bemezid – kiddesh.
Uvahekdesh, bemezid – kiddesh, uveshogeg – lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg – kiddesh, bemezid – lo kiddesh.
Gemara nema matnitin dela kerabbi yose haggelili, detanya: "umaala maal baAdonai" – lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamono, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Afillu tema rabbi yose haggelili, ki kaamar rabbi yose haggelili – mechayyim, aval leachar shechita – la. may tama? ki ka zachu – mishshulchan gavoah ka zachu.
Dayka name, dekatane: hamekaddesh bechelko, ben kodshe kodashim uven kodashim kallim – lo kiddesh. shema minna.

Tanu rabbanan: leachar petirato shel rabbi meir amar lahem rabbi yehuda letalmidav: al yikkansu talmide rabbi meir lechan, mippene shekkanteranim hem, velo lilmod tora hem baim ella lekappecheni bahalachot hem baim. dachak somchos venichnas. amar lahem: kach shana li rabbi meir: hamekaddesh bechelko, ben kodshe kodashim uven kodashim kallim – lo kiddesh.

Kaas rabbi yehuda (alehem). amar lahem: lo kach amarti lachem: al yikkansu mittalmide rabbi meir lechan mippene shekkanteranim hem, velo lilmod tora hem baim ella lekappecheni bahalachot hem baim. vechi ishsha baazara minnayin?!

Amar rabbi yose: yomru: meir shachav, yehuda kaas, yose shatak – (divre) tora ma tehe aleha? vechi en adam asuy lekabbel kiddushin levitto baazara? veen ishsha asuya laasot lah shaliach lekabbel kiddusheha baazara? veod: dachaka venichnesa may?

Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: mekuddeshet, rabbi yose omer: enah mekuddeshet. amar rabbi yochanan: shenehem mikra echad darshu: "ze yihye lecha mikkodesh hakkodashim min haesh". rabbi yehuda savar: "lecha" – ulechol tzerachecha. verabbi yose savar: keesh. ma esh laachila, af hu name laachila.
Amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Nimnu vegamru: hamekaddesh bechelko, ben kodshe kodashim uven kodashim kallim – lo kiddesh. verav amar: adayin hi machloket. amar abbaye: kevoteh derabbi yochanan mistabbera,
Detanya: minnayin sheen cholkim menachot keneged zevachim – talmud lomar: "vechol mincha asher teafe battannur... lechol bene aharon tihye".

Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged zevachim, shello kamu tachtehem bedallut, aval yachleku menachot keneged ofot, shehare kamu tachtehen bedallut? talmud lomar: "vechol naasa vammarcheshet... lechol bene aharon tihye".
Yachol lo yachleku menachot keneged ofot, shehallalu mine damim vehallalu mine kemachim, aval yachleku ofot keneged zevachim, shehallalu vehallalu mine damim? talmud lomar: "veal machavat".

Yachol lo yachleku ofot keneged zevachim, shehallalu maasehem bayyad vehallalu maasehem bichli, aval yachleku menachot keneged menachot, shehallalu vehallalu maasehem bayyad? talmud lomar: "vechol mincha velula vashshemen lechol bene aharon".

Yachol lo yachleku machavat keneged marcheshet umarcheshet keneged machavat, shezzo maaseha rakkim vezo maaseha kashim, aval yachleku machavat keneged machavat umarcheshet keneged marcheshet, shehallalu vehallalu maasehem kashim, i name maasehem rakkim? – talmud lomar: "vachareva lechol bene aharon tihye".
Yachol lo yachleku bekodshe kadashim aval yachleku bekadashim kallim? talmud lomar: "ish keachiv" usemich leh: "im al toda" – keshem sheen cholkin bekodshe kodashim kach en cholkim bekadashim kallim.
"Ish" ish cholek, afillu baal mum, veen hakkatan cholek vaafillu tam. setam sifra manni? rabbi yehuda, vehu kaamar delet ba din chalukah kelal. shema minna.

Amar rava: ucherav mi la tanya? vehatanya: hatztzenuim moshchin et yedehem, vehaggargeranim cholkim. may cholkim? chotfim, kidkatane sefa: maase beechad shechataf chelko vechelek chavero, vehayu korin oto: "ben chamtzan" ad yom moto.
Amar rabba bar rav shela: may keraa? "elohay palleteni miyyad rasha mikkaf meavvel vechometz". rabba amar: mehacha, "limdu hetev dirshu mishpat ashsheru chamotz"

Maaser sheni, ben beshogeg, ben bemezid – lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shogeg – lo kiddesh, mezid – kiddesh vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rav acha bereh derava mishshemeh digmara: "vechol masar haaretz mizzera haaretz mipperi haetz laAdonai hu kodesh laAdonai" – laAdonai hu, velo lekaddesh bo ishsha.
Hare terumat maaser, dichtiv: "ken tarimu gam attem terumat Adonai", utenan: hamekaddesh bitruma – mekuddeshet! – dela ketiv beh "laAdonai".
Vahare challa, dichtiv ba: "tittenu laAdonai", utenan: hamekaddesh bitrumot – mekuddeshet! – dela ketiv bay "kodesh".
Vahare sheviit, dichtiv ba: "yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem", utenan: hamekaddesh beferot sheviit – mekuddeshet! – dela ketiv bay "laAdonai".
Vahare teruma, dichtiv: "kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit tevuato", utenan: hamekaddesh bitruma – mekuddeshet! hahu beyisrael ketiv.
b: Velav mimmela shamat minna? targema ravin sava kammeh derav: amar kera: "hu" – bahavayayto yehe.

Uvahekdesh, bemezid – kiddesh, beshogeg – lo kiddesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg – kiddesh, bemezid – lo kiddesh. amar rabbi yaakov: shemait minne derabbi yochanan tarte: shiggat maaser derabbi yehuda, shiggat hekdesh derabbi meir – shenehem en ishsha mitkaddeshet bahem.

Chada – lefi sheen ishsha rotza, vachada – lefi sheen shenehem rotzim, vela yadana he minnayyhu. amar rabbi yirmeya: nichze anan: maaser – ihi la nicha la mishshum tircha deorcha, ihu nicha leh denikne itteta mimmela. ella hekdesh – tarvayyhu la nicha lehu denittachil hekdesh al yedayyhu.

Verabbi yaakov amar: ippecha mistabbera, mi la ikka lememar: maaser, ihi la nicha la mishshum tircha deorcha, ihu la nicha leh mishshum unesa deorcha?! ella hekdesh, bishlama ihi la nicha la denittachil hekdesh al yeda, ella ihu mi la nicha leh denikne itteta mimmela?
Bea minneh rava merav chisda: ishsha en mitkaddeshet, maot mahu sheyyetzu lechullin? amar leh: ishsha en mitkaddeshet – maot heach yetzu lechullin?
Bea minne rav chiyyay bar avin merav chisda: bemecher may? amar leh: af bemecher lo kana.
Etiveh: chenvani kevaal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: chenvani keshulechani.

Ad kan la ka mippalgi ella demar savar: chenvani keshulechani, umar savar chenvani kevaal habbayit. aval dechulle alma: im hotzi – maal! rabbi meir lidvarav derabbi yehuda kaamar: ledidi, im hotzi name lo maal, ella ledidach, odi li miha dechenvani kevaal habbayit! vaamar leh: la, keshulechani.
Amar rav:

a: Chazarnu al kol tzedadim shel rabbi meir, velo matzinu hekdesh beshogeg en mitchallel, bemezid mitchallel.
Umishnatenu bechotnot kehunna shello balu, hoil venittenu lehanot bahen, lefi shello nittena tora lemalache hashsharet.
Ta shema: kotnot kehunna shebbalu moalin bahem, divre rabbi meir. may lav afillu lo balu? la, balu davka.
Ta shema: moalim bechadtin veen moalim beattikim. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: moalin af beattikim, shehaya rabbi meir omer: moalin bishyare hallishka.

Veammay? nema: hoil venittenu lehanot, lefi shello nittena tora lemalache hashsharet, deha chomat hair umigdeloteha mishsheyare hallishka atu, ditnan: chomat hair umigdeloteha, vechol tzorche hair bain mishsheyare hallishka. la tema rabbi meir, ella ema rabbi yehuda.
Ta shema: detanya, amar rabbi yishmael bar rabbi yitzchak: avne yerushalayim shennashru moalim bahem, divre rabbi meir. la tema rabbi meir, ella ema rabbi yehuda.
I rabbi yehuda, yerushalayim mi mikkaddesha? vehatnan: keimmera, kaddirim, kaetzim, kaishshim, kahechol, kammizbeach, kirushalayim. rabbi yehuda omer: kol haomer: "yerushalayim" lo amar kelum.
Vechi tema, mishshum delo amar: "kirushalayim", vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: kol haomer "kirushalayim" – lo amar kelum, ad sheyyiddor bedavar hakkarev birushalayim!
b: Tere tannae ninhu veallibba derabbi yehuda.

Amar ulla mishshemeh devar peda, omer haya rabbi meir: hekdesh bemezid – mitchallel, beshogeg – en mitchallel. velo amru beshogeg mitchallel ella leinyan korban bilvad. vechi meachar deen mitchallel, korban bemay michayyayv?!
Ella ki ata ravin paresh mishshemeh devar peda, omer haya rabbi meir: hekdesh bemezid – mitchallel, beshogeg – en mitchallel. velo amru beshogeg mitchallel ella leinyan achila bilvad.
Amar rav nachman amar rav adda bar ahava: halacha kerabbi meir bemaaser hoil usetam lan tena kevateh, vahalacha kerabbi yehuda behekdesh hoil usetam lan tena kevateh.
Kerabbi meir bemaaser, may hi – ditnan: kerem revai, bet shammay omrim: en lo chomesh veen lo biur. uvet hillel omrim: yesh lo.
Bet shammay omrim: yesh lo peret veyesh lo olelot. uvet hillel omrim: kullo laggat.
May tama devet hillel – gamri "kodesh" "kodesh" mimmaaser, ma maaser yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur – af kerem revai yesh lo chomesh veyesh lo biur. uvet shammay la gamri "kodesh" "kodesh" mimmaaser.
Uvet hillel omrim kemaaser, keman sevira lehu? i kerabbi yehuda, ammay kullo laggat? haamar maaser mamon hedyot hu! ella lav kerabbi meir!
Kerabbi yehuda behekdesh may hi – ditnan: shillach beyad pikkeach venizkar ad shello higgia etzel chenvoni – chenvoni maal lichsheyyotzi.

Ucherabbi yehuda bemaaser mi la tenan? vehatnan: happode maaser sheni shello – mosif alav chamishito, ben mishshello ben shennittan lo bemattana. manni? ilema rabbi meir hi – mi matze yahev leh bemattana? vehaamar: maaser mamon gavoah hu! ella lav rabbi yehuda!
La, leolam rabbi meir vehacha bemay askinan, kegon deyahev nihaleh betivleh, vekasavar: mattanot shello huremu kemi shello huremu damyayn.

Ta shema: happode neta revai shello – mosif alav chamishito, ben mishshello, ben shennittan lo bemattana. manni? ilema rabbi meir – mi matze yahev leh? veha gamri "kodesh" "kodesh" mimmaaser! ella lav rabbi yehuda?
Leolam rabbi meir, vehacha bemay askinan, kegon deyahev keshehu semadar. udela kerabbi yose, deamar: semadar asur, mippene shehu peri.

Ta shema: mashach hemennu maaser besela velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bishtayim – noten sela, umistakker besela, umaaser sheni shello. manni? ilema rabbi meir, ammay mistakker besela? "venatan et hakkesef vekam lo" amar rachamana! ella lav rabbi yehuda!
Leolam rabbi yehuda, vehacha chad setama, vehacha tere setame.
Vei setama davka, ma li chad setama ma li tere setame?! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: halacha kerabbi meir hoil utenan bivchirata kevoteh.

a: Tenan hatam: behema shennimtzet mirushalayim lemigdal eder uchemiddatah lechol ruach, zecharim – olot, nekevot – zivche shelamim.

Ella zecharim, olot hu dehavu, zivche shelamim la havu? amar rabbi oshaya: hacha bava lachuv bidmehen askinan, vehachi kaamar: chayyshinan shemma olot, verabbi meir hi, deamar: hekdesh bemezid mitchallel.
Ukedushshat hagguf mi mitchallel? vehatnan: en moel achar moel bemukedashin ella bivhema uvichli sharet bilvad.

Ketzad? haya rochev al gabbe behema, ba chavero verachav, ba chavero verachav – kullam maalu. haya shote bechos shel zahav, ba chavero veshata, ba chavero veshata – kullam maalu! hahi – rabbi yehuda hi, ha rabbi meir.

Midderabbi yehuda nishma lerabbi meir – lav amar rabbi yehuda: hekdesh beshogeg mitchallel ukedushshat hagguf la mittachala. lerabbi meir name, af al gav dehekdesh bemezid mitchallel kedushshat hagguf la mittachala! hatam la ka mechavven leappokinhu lechullin. hacha – ka mechavven leappokinhu lechullin.

Emar deshamat leh lerabbi meir bekodshe kodashim, bekadashim kallim mi shamat leh? – amar leh hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh: kal vachomer: kodshe kodashim mitchallelim – kodashim kallim lo kol shekken?!

Ittemar name, amar rabbi chama berabbi akiva, amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: omer haya rabbi meir: hekdesh bemezid – mitchallel, beshogeg – en mitchallel, echad kodshe kodashim veechad kodashim kallim. kal vachomer: kodshe kodashim mitchallelim – kodashim kallim lo kol shekken?!
b: Tahe ba rabbi yochanan: vechi omrim lo laadam: amod vachata bishvil shettizke? ella amar rabbi yochanan: mamtin la ad shettumam, umayyte shete behemot umatne.
Amar mar: zecharim – olot. dilma toda hi? demayyte name toda. veha baaya lechem! demayyte name lechem.
Vedilma asham hu? asham ben shete shanim, veishtechach ben shana. vedilma asham metzora hu, asham nazir hu? la shechichi.
Vedilma pesach hu? pesach bizmanno, mizhar zehiri beh, veshello bizmanno – shelamim hu.
Vedilma bechor umaaser ninhu? lemay hilcheta, lemechlinhu bemuman? hachi name bemuman mitachli!
Amar mar: nekevot – zivche shelamim. dilma toda hi? demayyte toda. veha baaya lechem! demayyte name lechem.
Vedilma chattat hi? chattat bat shenatah, veishtechach bat shete shanim. vedilma chattat sheavra shenatah! la shechiach.
Ishtechach bat shenatah, may? tanya, chananya ben chachinay omer: ez bat shenatah lechattat. lechattat salka datach?! ella amar abbaye: kechattat – konsah lechippa vehi meta meeleha.
Tanu rabbanan: en lokchim behema bimot maaser sheni,

a: Veim lakach beshogeg – yachzeru damim limkomam. bemezid – taale veteachel bammakom. amar rabbi yehuda: bamme devarim amurim – bemitkavven velakach techilla leshem shelamim, aval bemitkavven lehotzi meot maaser sheni lechullin, ben shogeg ben mezid – yachzeru damim limkomam.
Vehaanan tenan: rabbi yehuda omer: bemezid – kiddesh! amar rabbi elazar: ishsha yodaat sheen meot maaser sheni mitchallelin al yadah, veola veochalto birushalayim.

Matkef la rabbi yirmeya: vahare behema temea, avadim vekarkaot, deadam yodea sheen meot maaser sheni mitchallelin alehen, utenan: en lokchim behema temea avadim vekarkaot bimot maaser sheni afillu birushalayim. veim lakach – yochal kenegdan!
Ella hacha beishsha chavera askinan, deyada.
Amar mar: im lakach yochal kenegdan. veammay? yachzeru damav limkomam, ki hatam!
Amar shemuel:
b: Keshebbarach. vetama devarach, ha lo barach – kansinan lemocher. venikneseh lelokeach! lav achbera gannav ella chora gannav.
Vei la achbera, chora may kaaved? mistabbera, kol hecha deikka issura – hatam kansinan.

Mishna hamekaddesh beorla, bechile hakkerem, beshor hanniskal, uveegla arufa, betzippore metzora, uvisar nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vechullin shennishchatu baazara – enah mekuddeshet. mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen – mekuddeshet.

Gemara beorla menalan? detanya: "arelim lo yeachel" – en li ella issur achila, hanaa minnayin? shello yehane mimmennu, velo yitzba bo, velo yadlik bo et hanner? talmud lomar: "vaaraltem et orlato" – lerabbot et kullam.
Bechile hakkerem menalan? amar chizkiyya: amar kera: "pen tikdash" – pen tukad esh.
Rav ashe amar: "pen yihye kodesh". i ma kodesh tofes et damav veyotze lechullin – af kile hakkerem tofes et damav veyotze lechullin! ella mechavvavrta kidchizkiyya.

"Shor hanniskal" minnayin? detanya: mimmashma shenneemar: "sakol yissakel hashshor" – eni yodea shennevela hi, unevela asura baachila? ma talmud lomar: "lo yeachel et besaro"? maggid lach sheim shechato leachar shennigmar dino – asur baachila.
Bahanaa minnayin? talmud lomar: "uvaal hashshor naki". may mashma? shimon ben zoma omer: keadam sheomer lachavero: "yatza peloni naki minnechasav veen lo bahem hanaa shel kelum".

Mimmay dehay "lo yeachel et besaro" lehecha deshachet leachar shennigmar dino hu daata? dilma hecha deshachet leachar shennigmar dino shere, veha "lo yeachel" – hecha desakleh miskal hu daata, vechidrabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar.

Deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: kol makom shenneemar: "lo yochal" "lo tochal" velo tochlu" – echad issur achila veechad issur hanaa, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha binvela!
Hane mille hecha denafka lan issur achila millo yochal", hacha issur achila missakol yissakel" nafka. dei salka datach leissur hanaa hu dichtiv, nichtov kera: "lo yehane".
I name: "lo yeachel", "et besaro" lema li?! af al gav deshachteh keen basar – asur.

Matkef la mar zutera: veema hane mille hecha devadak tzur veshachat bah, demichaze kiskila, aval shachteh besakkin – la! midde sakkin beorayyta ketiv? veod tanya: bakkol shochatin, ben betzor, ben bizchuchit, ben bikrumit shel kane.

Vehasheta denafka lan issur achila veissur hanaa tarvayyhu millo yeachel", hay "baal hashshor naki" lemay ata? lahanaat oro. salka datach amena: "lo yeachel et besaro" ketiv, besaro asur veoro muttar.
Ulehanach tannae demappeki leh hay "baal hashshor naki" lachatzi kofer velidme valdot, hanaat oro mena lehu?
Meet besaro", et hattafel livsaro. veiddach?

a: "Et" la daresh. kidtanya: shimon haamsoni veamri la nechemya haamsoni haya doresh kol ettin shebbattora. kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira", perash.

Amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kol ettin sheddarashta ma tehe alehem? amar lahem: keshem shekkibbalti sachar al hadderisha, kach kibbalti al happerisha. ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed: "et Adonai elohecha tira" – lerabbot talmide chachamim.
Beegla arufa: menalan? amri deve rabbi yannay: "kappara" ketiv ba, kekadashim.
"Tzippore metzora" menalan? detana deve rabbi yishmael: neemar machshir umechapper mibbifnim, veneemar machshir umechapper mibbachutz.
Ma machshir umechapper haamur bifnim asa bo machshir kimchapper – af machshir umechapper haamur bachutz asa bo machshir kimchapper.

Ittemar: tzippore metzora meematay asurim? rabbi yochanan amar: mishsheat shechita, veresh lakish amar: mishsheat lekicha. rabbi yochanan amar mishsheat shechita, shechita hu deasra la. resh lakish amar: mishsheat lekicha, meegla arufa nafka, ma egla arufa mechayyim – af tzippore metzora mechayyim.

Veegla arufa gufa meematay? amar rabbi yannay: gevul shamati bah veshachachti, venasvin chavrayya lomar: yeridatah lenachal etan hi osartah. i ma egla arufa mishsheat lekicha la mittasra, af tzippore metzora name mishsheat lekicha la mittasri! hachi hasheta?! hatam it leh gevul acharina, hacha mi it leh gevul acharina?!

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: "kol tzippor tehora tochelu" – lerabbot et hameshullachat, "veze asher lo tochlu mehem" – lerabbot et hashshechuta. vei salka datach mechayyim asura, leachar shechita mibbaya?! mahu detema midde dehave akkodashim, demechayyim asiri, veatya shechita umachshera lehu, ka mashma lan.

Etiveh: shechatah venimtzet terefa – yikkach zug lashsheniyya, veharishona mutteret bahanaa. vei salka datach mechayyim asura, harishona ammay mutteret bahanaa? amar leh: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shennimtzet terefa bivne meeha, dela chal ala kedushsha kelal.
Etiveh: shechatah shello beezov veshello beetz erez veshello bishni tolaat, rabbi yaakov omer: hoil vehuketza lemitzvatah – asura, rabbi shimon omer: hoil venishchata shello kemitzvatah – mutteret.
Ad kan la peligi ella mar savar: shechita sheenah reuya – shemah shechita, umar savar: shechita sheenah reuya – lo shemah shechita. dechulle alma miha mechayyim la mittasra!
Tannae hi, detana deve rabbi yishmael: neemar machshir umechapper mibbifnim, veneemar machshir umechapper bachutz.
Ma machshir umechapper haamur bifnim – asa bo machshir kimchapper, af machshir umechapper haamur bachutz – asa bo machshir kimchapper.
Gufa: "kol tzippor tehora tochelu" – lerabbot et hameshullachat, "veze asher lo tochlu mehem" – lerabbot et hashshechuta.
Veefoch ana! amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: lo matzinu baale chayyim sheasurim. matkef la rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: vela hare
b: Muketze veneevad, devaale chayyim ninhu vaasiri! ki asiri – legavoah, lehedyot – mishre shere.
Matkef la rabbi yirmeya: hare rovea venirba beedim, devaale chayyim ninhu vaasiri! ella: amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: lo matzinu rov baale chayyim sheasurim.

Deve rabbi yishmael tana: deamar kera: "veshillach al pene hassade" – kesade, ma sade mutteret – af hay name mutteret. hay "sade" lehachi hu daata? hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "sade" – shello yaamod beyafo veyizrekenna layyam, bigvat veyizrekenna lammidbar, veshello yaamod chutz lair veyizrekenna betoch hair. ella kol sheomed bair veyizrekenna chutz lachoma.
Veiddach? im ken nichtov kera: "sade", may "hassade"? shema minna tarte.
Rava amar: lo amra tora: "shallach" letakkala.
Bisar nazir. menalan? deamar kera "kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho" – giddulo yihye kadosh.
I ma kodesh tofes et damav, veyotze lechullin – af sear nazir tofes et damav veyotze lechullin! mi karenan "kodesh"? "kadosh" karenan.
Befeter chamor. nema matnitin dela kerabbi shimon, detanya: peter chamor asur bahanaa, divre rabbi yehuda, verabbi shimon mattir. amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: leachar arifa, vedivre hakkol.
Basar bechalav. menalan? detana deve rabbi yishmael: "lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo" shalosh peamim: echad issur achila, veechad issur hanaa, veechad issur bishshul.

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna. detanya, rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer: basar bechalav asur baachila umuttar bahanaa, shenneemar: "ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha lo tevashshel gedi bachalev immo", ulehallan hu omer: "veanshe kodesh tihyun li". ma lehallan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa – af kan asur baachila umuttar bahanaa.

Vechullin shennishchatu baazara. mena hane mille? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: amra tora: shechot li – beshelli. veshellach – beshellach. ma shelli beshellach – asur, af shellach beshelli – asur.

I ma shelli beshellach anush karet, af shellach beshelli anush karet? amar kera: "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio lehakeriv korban laAdonai... venichrat", al korban – anush karet, al chullin shennishchatu baazara – en anush karet.
Ikka lemifrach: ma leshelli beshellach – shekken anush karet!
Ella amar abbaye: mehacha: "ushechato" "veshachat oto" "veshachat oto". telata kerae yattire, ma talmud lomar?
Lefi shenneemar: "ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom... vezavachta", berichuk makom atta zoveach vei atta zoveach bemakom karov, perat lechullin shello yishshachatu baazara.

Veen li ella temimim haruyim likkarev, minnayin lerabbot baale mumin? merabbe ani et baale mumim, shekken: min hammachshir. minnayin lerabbot et hachayya? merabbe ani et hachayya, shehi bishchita kivhema. minnayin lerabbot et haofot? talmud lomar: "ushechato" "veshachat oto" "veshachat oto".

Yachol lo yishchot, veim shachat yehe muttar? talmud lomar: "ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom... vezavachta... veachalta", ma sheatta zoveach berichuk makom – atta ochel, vei atta ochel ma sheatta zoveach bemakom karov, perat lechullin shennishchatu baazara.
Veen li ella temimim

a: Haruyim likrav, minnayin lerabbot baale mumin? merabbe ani baale mumin, shekken: min hammachshir. uminnayin lerabbot et hachayya? merabbe ani et hachayya, shehi bishchita kivhema. minnayin lerabbot et haofot? talmud lomar: "ushechato" "veshachat oto" "veshachat oto".
Yachol lo yishchot, veim shachat yashlichennu lifne chelavim? talmud lomar: "lakkelev tashlichun oto" – oto atta mashlich lakkelev, vei atta mashlich chullin shennishchatu baazara.

Ashkechinhu mar yehuda lerav yosef ulerav shemuel bereh derabba bar bar chana dahavo kayymi appitcha deve rabba. amar lehu: tanya: hamekaddesh befeter chamor, bevasar bechalav, uvechullin shennishchatu baazara, rabbi shimon omer: mekuddeshet, vachachamim omrim: enah mekuddeshet. alma chullin shennishchatu baazara lerabbi shimon lav deorayyta.
Ureminhu: rabbi shimon omer: chullin shennishchatu baazara – yissarfu, vechen chayya shennishchata baazara. ishtiku.
Ato lekammeh derabba. amar lehu: palgaa[5] okminchu, hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennishchata venimtzet terefa. verabbi shimon letameh.
Detanya: hashshochet et hatterefa vechen hashshochet venimtzet terefa – ze vaze chullin baazara. rabbi shimon mattir bahanaa, vachachamim osrim.

Mecharan vekiddesh bidmehen – mekuddeshet. menalan? middegalli rachamana baavoda zara: "vehayita cherem kamohu", kol sheatta mehayye hemenna – hare hu kamohu, mikkelal dechol issurim shebbattora sheru.
Venelaf minna! mishshum dehave avoda zara usheviit shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbaim keechad en melammedin.
Avoda zara – ha daamaran. sheviit may hi? "yovel hi kodesh tihye lachem" – ma kodesh tofes et damav, af sheviit tofeset dameha.
I ma kodesh tofes et damav veyotze lechullin, af sheviit tofeset dameha veyotza lechullin? talmud lomar: "tihye" – bahavayaytah tehe.

Ketzad? lakach beferot sheviit basar – ellu vaellu mitbaarim bashsheviit. babbasar dagim – yatza basar nichnesu dagim. bedagim yayin – yatzu dagim nichnas yayin. beyayin shemen – yatza yayin nichnas shemen. ha ketzad? acharon acharon nitpas bashsheviit, ufeyri atzmo asur.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin may ikka lememar? [tere] miute ketivi, ketiv hacha: "ki cherem hu", uchetiv hatam: "yovel hi" – hi in, midde acharina la.
Mishna hamekaddesh bitrumot uvammaasrot, uvammattanot, uveme chattat, uveefer chattat – hare zo mekuddeshet, vaafillu yisrael.
Gemara amar ulla: tovat hanaa enah mamon. etiveh rabbi abba leulla: hamekaddesh bitrumot, uvemaasrot, uvammattanot beme chattat, uveefer para – hare zo mekuddeshet, vaafillu yisrael.
Amar leh: hacha beyisrael shennaflu lo tevalim mibbet avi immo kohen. veka savar: mattanot shello huremu kemi shehuremu damyayn.

Bea minneh rabbi chiyyay bar avin merav huna: tovat hanaa mamon o enah mamon? amar leh: tenetuha: hamekaddesh bitrumot uvemaasrot uvemattanot beme chattat uveefer para – hare zo mekuddeshet, vaafillu yisrael! amar leh: velav okemna beyisrael shennaflu lo tevalim mibbet avi immo kohen?
b: Amar leh: hutzaa at. ikkesif, hu savar: mishshemata kaamar leh. amar leh: hachi kaamena: rav assi dehutzal kae kevataych.

Nema ketannae: haggonev tivlo shel chavero – meshallem lo deme tivlo shel chavero, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: eno meshallem ella deme chullin shebbo. may lav beha kamippalgi, demar savar: tovat hanaa mamon, umar savar: tovat hanaa enah mamon.

La, dechulle alma tovat hanaa enah mamon, vehacha bitvalim shennaflu lo mibbet avi immo kohen uvemattanot shello huremu kemi shehuremu damyayn kamippalgi. mar savar: kemi shehuremu damyayn. umar savar: lav kemi shehuremu damyayn.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma kemi shehuremu damyayn vetovat hanaa enah mamon, vehacha bedishmuel kamippalgi. deamar shemuel: chitta achat poteret et hakkeri.
Demar it leh dishmuel. umar let leh dishmuel.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma let lehu dishmuel, vehacha hayeynu tama derabbi, dekansuhu rabbanan legannav.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma it lehu dishmuel vehacha hayeynu tama derabbi yose berabbi yehuda, dekansuhu rabbanan levaal habbayit, dela ibbei leh leshahoye letivleh.

Tenan: hamekaddesh bitrumot, uvammaasrot, uvammattanot, beme chattat, uveefer para – hare zo mekuddeshet veaf al pi yisrael. ureminhu: hannotel sachar ladun – dinav betelim, lehaid – eduto betela, lehazzot ulekaddesh – memav me meara, veefro efer mikle!
Amar abbaye: la kashya, kan besachar havaa umilluy, kan bischar hazzaa vekiddush.
Dayka name, dekatane hacha: "beme chattat uveefer para", vekatane hatam: "lehazzot ulekaddesh". shema minna.
Hadaran alach haish mekaddesh

Haomer lachavero: "tze vekaddesh li ishsha pelonit", vehalach vekiddeshah leatzmo – mekuddeshet lashsheni. vechen haomer leishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheloshim yom" uva acher vekiddesha betoch sheloshim yom – mekuddeshet lishne. bat yisrael lechohen – tochal bitruma.
"Meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom" uva acher vekiddesha betoch sheloshim yom – mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet. bat yisrael lechohen, o vat kohen leyisrael – lo tochal bitruma.
Gemara haomer lachavero "tze vekaddesh". tana: ma sheasa asuy, ella shennahag bo minhag rammaut. vetanna didan, "halach" name dekatane – halach berammaut.
May shena hacha dekatane "haomer lachavero",

a: Umay shena hatam dekatane "haomer lishlucho"?

Hacha revuta ka mashma lan, vehatam revuta ka mashma lan. hacha revuta ka mashma lan: dei tena "shelucho" hava amena: shelucho hu dehave rammay, desamcha dateh, savar: aved li shelichutay, aval chavero, dela samcha dateh, ema la leheve rammay.

Hatam revuta ka mashma lan: dei tena: "haomer lachavero" hava amena: chavero hu dechi kiddeshah bemakom acher enah mekuddeshet, desavar: la tarach, aval shelucho detarach ema: mare makom hu lo, ka mashma lan.

Ravin chasida azayl lekaddoshe leh itteta livreh, kaydsha lenafsheh. vehatanya: ma sheasa – asuy, ella shennahag bo minhag rammaut! la yahavu nihaleh. ibbei leh leodoe! savar: addehachi vehachi ata inish acharina mekaddesh la.

Rabba bar bar chana yehayv leh zuze lerav, amar: zivna nihali lehay ara. azal zavna lenafsheh. vehatanya: ma sheasa – asuy, ella shennahag bo minhag rammaut! baga deallime hava (leh), lerav – nahagi beh kavod, lerabba bar bar chana – la nahagi beh kavod. ibbei leh leodoe! sevar: addehachi vehachi ata inish acharina zabben la.

Rav giddel hava mehappech behahi ara. azal rabbi abba zavna. azal rav giddel kavleh lerabbi zera. azal rabbi zera vekavleh lerav yitzchak nappacha. amar leh: hameten ad sheyyaale etzlenu laregel. ki selek, ashkecheh, amar leh: ani mehappech bacharara, uva acher unetalah hemennu, may?

Amar leh: nikra rasha. veella mar may tama avad hachi? amar leh: la hava yadana. hasheta name nitteva nihaleh mar. amar leh: zabbone la mezabbenna la, deara kammayyta hi, vela mesammena milleta. i bae bemattana – nishkeleh.
Rav giddel la nachet la, dichtiv: "vesone mattanot yichye". rabbi abba la nachet la mishshum dehappech ba rav giddel. la mar nachet la vela mar nachet la umitkarya ara derabbanan.
Vechen haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li kulei. lo ba acher vekiddesha betoch sheloshim, mahu? rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: mekuddeshet, veaf al pi shennitakkelu hammaot.
May tama? hane zuze la lemilva damu vela lefikkadon damu.
Lefikkadon la damu – pikkadon birshuta demareh ka mitakkeli, vehane birshuta dida ka mitakkeli. lemalve name la damu – milva lehotzaa nittena, hane betorat kiddushin yahavinhu nihala.
Lo ba acher vekiddeshah, vechazra bah, mahu? rabbi yochanan amar: chozeret – ate dibbur, umevattel dibbur. resh lakish amar: enah chozeret – la ate dibbur umevattel dibbur.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: bittel, im ad shello taram bittel – en terumato teruma. veha hacha dedibbur vedibbur hu, vekaate dibbur umevattel dibbur! shane netinat maot leyad ishsha, dechi maase damu, vela ate dibbur umevattel maase.

Etiveh: hashsholeach get leishto vehiggia bashshaliach o sheshshalach acharav shaliach veamar lo: "get shennatatti lecha batel hu" – hare ze batel. veha netinat get leyad shaliach, dechi netinat maot leyad ishsha dame, vekatane hare ze batel!
Hatam name, kol kamma dela meta gitta lida – dibbur vedibbur hu, ate dibbur umevattel dibbur.
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: kol hakkelim yordin lide tumeatan bemachshava, veen olim midde tumeatan ella beshinnuy maase.
b: Maase motzi miyyad maase umiyyad machshava, machshava en motzia lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machshava. bishlama miyyad maase la mappeka, dela ate dibbur umevattel maase, ella miyyad machshava miha tappek!
Shane machshava detumea, dechi maase dame, vechidrav pappa. derav pappa rame: ketiv: "ki yitten", vekarenan: "ki yuttan". ha ketzad?
"Ki yuttan" duvmya "dechi yitten". ma "yitten" denicha leh, af "yuttan", denicha leh.

Rav zevid matne leha shemateta aha: vechen hi shennatna reshut lishluchah lekaddeshah, vehalcha hi vekiddeshah et atzmah, im shellah kadmu – kiddusheha kiddushin, veim shel sheluchah kadmu – en kiddusheha kiddushin.

Lo kiddeshah et atzmah vechazra bah, mahu? rabbi yochanan amar: chozeret, veresh lakish amar: enah chozeret. rabbi yochanan amar: chozeret, ate dibbur umevattel dibbur. resh lakish amar: enah chozeret, la ate dibbur umevattel dibbur.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: bittel, im ad shello taram bittel – en terumato teruma! amar rava: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shekkadam baal habbayit vetaram et kiryo, dehave leh maase.

Etiveh resh lakish: kol hakkelim yordim lide tumeatan bemachshava, veen olin mittumeatan ella beshinnuy maase. maase motzi miyyad maase umiyyad machshava, machshava enah motzia lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machshava. bishlama miyyad maase la mappeka, la ate dibbur umevattel maase, ella miyyad machshava miha tappek!

Amar leh: shane machshava detumea dechi maase dame, vechidrav pappa. derav pappa rame: ketiv: "ki yitten", vekarenan: "ki yuttan". ha ketzad? "ki yuttan" duvmya "dayitten", ma "yitten" denicha leh af "yuttan" name denicha leh.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: hashsholeach get leishto vehiggia bashshaliach o sheshshalach acharav shaliach veamar lo: "get shennatatti lecha batel hu" – hare ze batel teyuveta deresh lakish, teyuveta.
Vehilcheta kevoteh derabbi yochanan, vaafillu bekammayyta. veaf al gav deikka lememar: shane netinat maot leyad ishsha dichmaase dame, afillu hachi ate dibbur umevattel dibbur.
Kashya hilcheta ahilcheta. amrat: hilcheta kerabbi yochanan, vekayyma lan hilcheta kerav nachman, deibbaya lehu: mahu sheyyachazor vigaresh bo?
Rav nachman amar: chozer umegaresh bo, rav sheshet amar: eno chozer umegaresh bo. vekayyma lan hilcheta kevateh derav nachman! nehi devatteleh mittorat sheliach, mittorat get la batteleh.
Mekuddeshet lashsheni. amar rav: mekuddeshet lashsheni leolam, ushemuel amar: mekuddeshet lashsheni ad sheloshim yom, leachar sheloshim yom paki kiddushe sheni vegamri kiddushe rishon.
Yatev rav chisda veka kashya leh: kiddushe sheni bemay paki? amar leh rav yosef: mar aresha matne la vekashya leh, rav yehuda assefa matne la vela kashya leh:

"Meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom" vechulei. amar rav: mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet leolam. ushemuel amar: mekuddeshet veenah mekuddeshet ella ad sheloshim yom, leachar sheloshim paki kiddushe sheni vegamri kiddushe rishon.
Lerav mesappeka leh i tenaa havay, i chazara havay. lishmuel peshita leh ditnaa havay.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: "mehayyom uleachar mita" – get veeno get, divre chachamim. rabbi omer: kaze get.

Venema rav: halacha kerabbanan, venema shemuel halacha kerabbi! tzericha. deillu amar rav: halacha kerabbanan, hava amena: hatam dilrachoka kaate, aval hacha, dilkarova kaate, ema mode leh lishmuel ditnaah havay.
Vei amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi, hava amena: hatam hu deen get leachar mita. aval hacha deyesh kiddushin leachar sheloshim, ema mode leh lerav, tzericha.
Amar abbaye: uletameh derav, ba echad veamar lah: "hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom", uva acher veamar lah: "hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar esrim yom"

a: Uva acher veamar lah: "hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar asara yamim", merishon umeacharon – tzericha get, meemtzai – enah tzericha get.
Ma nafshach – i tenaa havay, dekamma kiddushe, dehanach lav kiddushe. i chazara havay, devatra kiddushe, dehanach lav kiddushe.
Peshita! mahu detema: hay lishshana mashma tenaa umashma chazara vetive gitta mikkol chad vechad, ka mashma lan.

Ulla amar rabbi yochanan: afillu mea tofsin bah. vechen amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: afillu mea tofsin bah. amar leh rav mesharsheya bereh derav amme lerabbi assi: asbera lach tama derabbi yochanan: shauo nafshayhu ki shirga delivne, dechol chad vechad revacha lechavreh shevak.
Metiv rav chanina: "mehayyom uleachar mita" – get veeno get, veim met – choletzet velo mityaybemet.
Bishlama lerav – mesayyeya leh, lishmuel name: ha manni – rabbanan hi, vaanan deamri kerabbi.
Ella lerabbi yochanan, deamar shiyyura have, kol gitta dimshayyayr ba vela kelum hu. yabbome meyaybem!
Amar rava: get lehotzi, umita lehotzi, ma sheshshiyyer get, gemarattu mita. amar leh abbaye: mi dame? get motzi mershut yavam, mita machneset lirshut yavam!
Ella amar abbaye: hatam tama may? gezera "mishshum mehayyom im matti" – hare ze get.
Venigzor "mehayyom im matti" detachlotz, attu "mehayyom uleachar mita"! im atta omer choletzet – mityaybemet.
Hacha name im atta omer choletzet – mityaybemet! tityaybem veen bechach kelum, chashasha derabbanan hu.

Mishna haomer leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheetten lich matayim zuz" – hare zo mekuddeshet, vehu yitten. "al menat sheetten lich mikkan vead sheloshim yom", natan lah betoch sheloshim – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet.
