"Al menat sheyyesh li matayim zuz" – hare zo mekuddeshet, veyesh lo. "al menat shearech matayim zuz" – hare zo mekuddeshet, veyare lah. veim hera al hashshulchan – enah mekuddeshet.

Gemara ittemar, rav huna amar: "vehu yitten". rav yehuda amar: "lichsheyyitten". rav huna amar: "vehu yitten" tenaa have, mekayyem tenaa veazel. rav yehuda amar: "lichsheyyitten" lechi yahev havu kiddushe, hasheta miha la havu kiddushe.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu sheppashta yadah vekibbela kiddushin meacher. lerav huna la havu kiddushe, lerav yehuda havu kiddushe.

Utenan name gabbe gittin ki hay gavvna: haomer leishsha "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz" – hare zo megoreshet, vehi titten. ittemar rav huna amar: "vehi titten". rav yehuda amar: "lichshettitten". rav huna amar: "vehi titten", tenaa have, mekayyeyma tenaa veazla. rav yehuda amar: "lichshettitten", lechi yahava leh hu dehave get, hasheta miha la have get.
b: May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shennitkara hagget o sheavad, lerav huna have get, lerav yehuda la have get.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan gabbe kiddushin, beha kaamar rav huna, mishshum dilkarova kaate, aval gerushin, dilrachoka kaate, ema mode leh lerav yehuda.
Vei ittemar behach: behach kaamar rav huna, mishshum deihu la kesif leh lemitbea, aval hacha, deihi kesifa la lemitbeeh ema mode leh lerav yehuda, tzericha.
Metivi: "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", af al pi shennitkara hagget o sheavad – hare zo megoreshet, leacher lo tinnase ad shettitten.

Veod tanya: amar lah "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz" vamet, natna – en zekuka layyavam, lo natna – zekuka leyavam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: notenet leachiv o leaviv o leechad min hakkerovim.
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar: "li velo leyorshayy", umar savar: "afillu leyorshayy", dechulle alma miha tenaa have, teyuveta derav yehuda!
Amar lach rav yehuda: ha manni – rabbi hi. deamar rav huna amar rabbi: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame, ufeligi rabbanan aleh. vaana daamari kerabbanan.

Gufa, amar rav huna amar rabbi: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame. amar rabbi zera: ki havenan bevavel hava amrinan: ha deamar rav huna amar rabbi: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame, peligi rabbanan aleh.
Ki salki lehatam ashkecheh lerabbi assi deyatev vekaamar la mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: hakkol modim beomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame, lo nechleku ella: "mehayyom uleachar mita".
Vehatanya: "mehayyom uleachar mita" – get veeno get, divre chachamim. rabbi omer: kaze get.
Ulerav yehuda, deamar beal menat" name peligi, addemippalgi bemehayyom uleachar mita" – niflege beal menat"?
Lehodiacha koach derabbi, demehayyom uleachar mita" name hare ze get. veniflegi beal menat", lehodiacha koach derabbanan! koach dehettera adif.
"Al menat sheetten lecha mikkan vechulei". peshita! mahu detema: lav tenaa hu, ulezarozeh kaamra[5], ka mashma lan.
"Al menat sheyyesh li matayim zuz" vechulei. venechush shemma yesh lo! veod, tanya: chayyshinan shemma yesh lo!
La kashya: ha bekiddushe vadday, ha bekiddushe safek.
"Al menat shearech matayim zuz" vechulei. tana: lo nitkavvena ella lirot mishshello. veim hera lah al hashshulchan – enah mekuddeshet. peshita! la tzericha deaf al gav denaket deme beiska.

Mishna "al menat sheyyesh li bet kor afar" – hare zo mekuddeshet, veyesh lo. "al menat sheyyesh li bemakom peloni", im yesh lo beoto makom – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. "al menat shearech bet kor afar" – hare zo mekuddeshet, veyarenna. veim herah babbika – enah mekuddeshet.
Gemara venechush shemma yesh lo! veod, tanya: chayyshinan shemma yesh lo! la kashya. ha bekiddushe vadday, ha bekiddushe safek.
Lema li lemitne gabbe ara ulema li lemitne gabbe zuze! tzericha, dei ashmeinan gabbe zuze, mishshum daavidi inashe dematznei. aval ara, ema: i deit leh ara – kala it leh, ka mashma lan.
"Al menat sheyyesh li bemakom peloni", im yesh lo vechulei. peshita! mahu detema: amar la: may nafka lach minna, ana tarachna umayytena! kamashma lan.
"Al menat shearech bet kor afar". tana: lo nitkavvevna zo ella lirot mishshello. veim herah babbika – enah mekuddeshet. peshita! la tzericha denaket bedistura.
Gabbe hekdesh tenan:

a: Hammakdish sadehu bishat hayyovel, noten bezera chomer seorim chamishshim shekel kasef. hayu nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim – en nimdadin immah. pachot mikkan – nimdadin immah.
Vehavenan ba: nehi devahade ara lo kadshu, nikdeshu beappe nafshayyhu! vechi tema: kamma dela have bet kor la chashiv, ureminhu:

"Sade" ma talmud lomar? – lefi shenneemar: "zera chomer seorim bachamishshim", en li ella shehikdish bainyan hazze, minnayin lerabbot, letech vachatzi letech, sea, tarkav, vachatzi tarkav, vaafillu rova minnayin? talmud lomar: "sade" – mikkol makom!
Amar mar ukeva bar chama: hacha binkaim meleim mayim askinan, mishshum delav bene zeria ninhu. dayka name, dekatane dumeya dislaim gevohim, shema minna.
I hachi, afillu pachot mikken name! hanhu negane deara mikkeru, shidra deara mikkeru.

Gabbe mecher tenan: haomer lachavero "bet kor afar ani mocher lach", vehayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim – en nimdadim immah. pachot mikkan – nimdadim immah. veamar mar ukeva bar chama: af al pi sheen meleim mayim.
May tama? amar rav pappa: lefi sheen adam rotze sheyyitten et meotav besade achat veyerae lo kishnayim vechashshelosha mekomot.
Hacha may? lehekdesh medammenan la, o lemecher medammenan la? mistabbera lehekdesh medammenan la, deamar la: ana tarachna vezarana umayytena.
Mishna rabbi meir omer: kol tenay sheeno kitnay bene gad uvene reuven – eno tenay. shenneemar: "vayyomer alehem im yaavru vene gad uvene reuven". uchetiv: "veim lo yaavru chalutzim".
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: tzarich haddavar leomro, sheilmale ken, yesh bammashma sheafillu beeretz kenaan lo yinchalu.
Gemara shappir kaamar leh rabbi chanina ben gamliel lerabbi meir! amar lach rabbi meir: i salka datach lav litnay kaful hu daata, lichtov: "veim lo yaavru venochazu vetochchem", "beeretz kenaan"
b: Lema li? shema minna litnay kaful hu daata.

Verabbi chanina ben gamliel amar: i la ketav rachamana "beeretz kenaan", hava amena "venochazu vetochchem" – beeretz gilad, aval eretz kenaan – kelal la. verabbi meir? "vetochchem" – kol hecha deit lechu mashma.

Tanya: amar rabbi chanina ben gamliel: mashal lema haddavar dome – leadam shehaya mechallek nechasav levanav, amar: peloni beni yirash sade pelonit, ufeloni beni yirash sade pelonit, ufeloni beni yitten matayim zuz veyirash sade pelonit, veim lo yitten – yirash im echav bishar nechasim.
Mi garam lo lirash im echav bishar nechasim – kefelo garam lo.
Veha la damya mashal lematnitin! hatam katane: yesh bammashma sheafillu beeretz kenaan lo yinchalu, alma kefela leeretz gilad name mahane.
Vehacha katane: mi garam lo lirash im echav bishar nechasim – kefelo garam lo, alma kefela lishar nechasim hu dekamahane!
La kashya. ha – mikkamme denema leh rabbi meir "venochazu",
Ha – levatar denema leh rabbi meir "venochazu".

Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv: "im tetiv seet, veim lo tetiv lappetach chattat rovetz". ella lerabbi chanina lema li? salka datach amena: im tetiv – agra, im lo tetiv – la agra vela dina, ka mashma lan.
Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv: "az tinnake mealati", ella lerabbi chanina ben gamliel lema li?
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hecha denicha la ledida vela nicha leh ledidhu mayyte beal kurchayyhu, ka mashma lan.
"Im lo tove haishsha" lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: hecha denicha lehu ledidhu vela nicha la ledida – nayyte beal kurcha, ka mashma lan.

Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv: "im bechukkotay telechu", "veim bechukkotay timasu", ella lerabbi chanina ben gamliel lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: "im bechukkotay telechu" – beracha, "im bechukkotay timasu" – lo beracha velo kelala, ka mashma lan.

Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv "im tovu ushematem vegomer", "veim temaanu umeritem vegomer", ella lerabbi chanina ben gamliel lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: "im tovu" – tova, "veim temaanu" – lo tova velo raa, ka mashma lan.
May

a: "Cherev teukkelu"? amar rava: milcha gelalnita, nahama disare akkusha, uvutzle. deamar mar: pat pureni chareva bemelach, uvetzalim – kashim lagguf kacharavot.
Bishlama lerabbi chanina ben gamliel, hayeynu dichtiv: "im lo shachav ish otach veim lo satit tuma tachat ishech hinnaki", ella lerabbi meir, "chinki" mibbee leh! amar rabbi tanchum: "hannaki" ketiv.

Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv: "hinnaki", ella lerabbi chanina ben gamliel lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: "im lo shachav ish" – hinnaki, "veim shachav" – lo hinnaki velo chinki, ella issura bealma, ka mashma lan.
Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv: "hu yitchatta vo bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii yithar veim lo yitchatta vegomer", ella lerabbi chanina ben gamliel lema li?
Itzterich, salka datach amena: mitzvat hazzaa bashshelishi uvashshevii, vehecha daavad bechad minnayyhu avad – ka mashma lan.

"Vehizza hattahor al hattame bayyom hashshelishi uvayyom hashshevii" lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: shelishi lemaote sheni, shevii lemaote shishshi, deka memaet bime tohora, aval hecha daavad bishlishi uvishmini, deka mappesh bime tohora – ema shappir dame, ka mashma lan.
"Vechitteo bayyom hashshevii" lema li? itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille lekodashim, aval litruma – bechad name saggi, ka mashma lan.

Mishna hamekaddesh et haishsha veamar: kesavur hayiti shehi kohenet vahare hi leviyya, leviyya vahare hi kohenet, aniyya vahare hi ashira, ashira vahare hi aniyya – hare zo mekuddeshet, mippene shello hitattu.

Haomer laishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer", o "leachar shettitgayyeyri", "leachar sheeshtachrer", o "leachar shettishtachreri", "leachar sheyyamut balich", o "leachar shettamut achotich", "leachar sheyyachlotz lich yevamich" – enah mekuddeshet.
Vechen haomer lachavero: "im yalda ishtecha nekeva hare zo mekuddeshet li" – enah mekuddeshet. im hayta eshet chavero meubberet vehukkar ubbarah – devarav kayyaymin, veim yalda nekeva – mekuddeshet.
Gemara tenan hatam: en tormin min hattalush al hamechubbar. veim taram – en terumato teruma.

Bea minneh rav assi merabbi yochanan: amar "perot aruga zo telushim yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo mechubbarim", "perot aruga zo mechubbarim yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo telushim lichsheyyittalshu" venitleshu, mahu? amar leh: kol shebbeyado lav kimchussar maase dame.

Etiveh: haomer laishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer", "leachar shettitgayyeyri", "leachar sheeshtachrer", "leachar shettishtachreri", "leachar sheyyamut balich", "leachar shettamut achotich", "leachar sheyyachlotz lich yevamich" – enah mekuddeshet.
Bishlama kullehu lav beyado, ella ger, have beyado! ger name lav beyado, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Ger tzarich shelosha. may tama: "mishpat" ketiv beh kaddin, mi yemar demizdakkeku leh hane telata.

Matkef la rabbi abba bar memel: ella meatta, hannoten peruta leshifchato, veamar: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheashachrerich" – hachi name dehavu kiddushin? hachi hasheta?! hatam – meikkara behema, hasheta – daat acheret.

Veella ha deamar rabbi oshaya: hannoten peruta leishto veamar lah: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheagarshich" – enah mekuddeshet, hachi name lerabbi yochanan dehavu kiddushin? nehi divyado legarshah, beyado lekaddeshah?

Tifshot devae rav oshaya: hannoten shete perutot leishsha, beachat amar lah: "hitkaddeshi li hayyom", uveachat amar lah: "hitkaddeshi li leachar sheagarshich", tifshot minna dela havu kiddushin! dilma ki hechi detafsi kiddushin hasheta – tafsi name leachar ken.

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan: en tormin min hattalush al hamechubbar, veim taram – en terumato teruma. ketzad? amar: "perot aruga zo telushin yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo mechubberet", "perot aruga zo mechubberet yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo telushin" – lo amar kelum. aval amar "lichsheyyittalshu" venitleshu – devarav kayyaymin.

Yater al ken amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: afillu amar "perot aruga zo telushin yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo mechubberet", "perot aruga zo mechubberet yihyu teruma al perot aruga zo telushin lichsheyyaviu shelish veyittalshu", veheviu shelish venitleshu – devarav kayyaymin.

Amar rabba: lo amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov ella beshachat, aval baagam – lo. rav yosef amar: afillu baagam. may mashma dehay agam lishshana devutzelana hu? amar rabbi elazar: deamar kera: "halachof keagmon rosho".

Keman azla ha detanya: haomer lachavero "im yalda ishtecha nekeva, mekuddeshet li" – lo amar kelum. veamar rabbi chanina: lo shanu ella sheen ishto meubberet, aval ishto meubberet – devarav kayyaymin. keman? i kerabba keshehukkar ubbarah, i kerav yosef – af al pi shello hukkar ubbarah.
Veikka deamri: amar rabba: la amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov ella beshachat deve chivsha, aval beshachat deve shakya – la. rav yosef amar: afillu beshachat deve shakya.

Keman azla ha detanya: haomer lachavero: "im yalda ishtecha nekeva mekuddeshet li" – lo amar kelum. veamar rabbi chanina: lo shanu ella sheen ishto meubberet, aval ishto meubberet – devarav kayyaymim. keman – keshehukkar ubbarah, vedivre hakkol.
Amar abbaye: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, verabbi, verabbi meir kullehu sevira lehu – adam makne davar shello ba leolam. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov – ha daamaran. rabbi – detanya:

a: "Lo tasgir eved el adonav", rabbi omer: belokeach eved al menat leshachrero hakkatuv medabber. hechi dame? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kegon dichtav leh: "lichsheekkachacha, hare atzmecha kanuy lecha meachshav".

Rabbi meir, detanya: haomer leishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheetgayyer", "leachar shettitgayyeyri", "leachar sheeshtachrer", "leachar shettishtachreri", "leachar sheyyamut balich", "leachar shettamut achotich", "leachar sheyyachlotz lach yevamich" – enah mekuddeshet. rabbi meir omer: mekuddeshet. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: enah mekuddeshet.
Rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: mekuddeshet. uma taam amru "enah mekuddeshet" – mishshum eva.
Venichshov name rabbi yehuda hannasi! hayeynu rabbi, hayeynu rabbi yehuda hannasi.
Venichshov name rabbi akiva, detanya: "kuvnnam sheani osa leficha" – en tzarich lehafer.
Rabbi akiva omer: yafer, shemma taadif alav yater min harauy lo. haittemar ala, amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: beomeret: "yikdeshu yaday leosehem", veyadayim itanhu baolam.

Mishna haomer laishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheadabber alayich lashshilton", "veeese immach kefoel", dibber aleha lashshilton veasa immah kefoel – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet.
Gemara amar resh lakish: vehu shennatan lah shave peruta. uvesachar la? vehatanya: bischar shehirkavtich al hachamor shehoshavtich bekaron o bisfina – enah mekuddeshet.
Bischar shearkivich al hachamor, sheoshivich bekaron o bisfina – mekuddeshet. vechi tema hacha name bedihav la shave peruta, veha bischar kaamar.

Veod tanya: shev immi betzavvta veekkaddesh lach, sechok lefanay, rekod lefanay, ase kaddimos hazze – shamin, im yesh bo shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. vechi tema, hacha name bedihav la shave peruta, veha shamin oto kaamar! teyuveta deresh lakish.
Amar lach resh lakish: hay tanna bara savar: enah lischirut ella levassof. vetanna didan savar yeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof.
Umay duchekeh deresh lakish leokomay lematnitin beyeshnah lischirut mittechilla vead sof, uvedihav la?
Amar rava: matnitin keshiteh, may irya detane "al menat"? nitne "bischar", ella shema minna: kol "al menat" hecha dihav la hu.
Mishna "al menat sheyyirtze abba", ratza haav – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. met haav – hare zo mekuddeshet. met habben – melammedin haav lomar sheeno rotze.
Gemara may "al menat sheyyirtze abba"? illema ad deamar abba "in", ema metziata: met haav – hare zo mekuddeshet, veha la amar "in"! ella:
b: Al menat sheyyishtok abba. ema sefa: met habben – melammedin et haav lomar sheeno rotze. ammay? veha shetek! ella amar la "al menat shello yemache abba".

Resha bechad tama umetziata vesefa bechad tama! amar rabbi yannay: in. amar resh lakish: shema minna lidrabbi yannay dachakinan umokminan matnitin bitre taame veallibba dechad tanna vela mokminan bitre tannae uvechad tama.
Rav yosef bar amme amar: leolam chad tama hu, umay "al menat sheyyirtze abba" – al menat shello yemache abba mikkan vead sheloshim yom.

Mishna "kiddashti et bitti veeni yodea lemi kiddashtiha", uva echad veamar "ani kiddashtiha" – neeman. ze amar "ani kiddashtiha" veze amar "ani kiddashtiha" – shenehem notnim get. veim ratzu – echad noten get, veechad kones.
Gemara amar rav: – neeman litten get, veen neeman lichnos. neeman litten get, en adam chote velo lo. veen neeman lichnos? ema yitzro tokfo.
Rav assi amar: af neeman lichnos. umode rav assi beomeret "nitkaddashti veeni yodaat lemi nitkaddashti" uva echad veamar "kiddashtiha" sheen neeman lichnos.
Tenan: ratzu – echad noten get veechad kones, teyuveta derav! amar lecha rav: shane hatam, dechevan deikka acher bahadeh – irtote mirtat.
Tanya kevoteh derav assi: kiddashti et bitti veeni yodea lemi kiddashtiha, uva echad veamar kiddashtiha – af neeman lichnos. kenasah uva acher veamar ani kiddashtiha – lo kol hemennu leosrah alav.
Haishsha sheamra "nitkaddashti veeni yodaat lemi nitkaddashti" uva echad veamar "ani kiddashti" – en neeman lichnos. mippene shehi mechappa alav.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu liskol al yado? rav amar: en soklin. verav assi amar: soklin.

Rav amar: en soklin, ki hemneh rachamana leav, leissura, liktala la hemneh. rav assi amar: soklin, lechulla milleteh hemneh rachamana leav. amar rav assi: umodena beomeret "nitkaddashti", sheen soklim.
Veamar rav assi: hane shematata didi merappesan iggare. hasheta, uma bimkom sheim ba lichnos kones – amarta soklim, mekom sheim ba lichnos en kones – eno din shessoklin?
Vela hi, leav hemneh rachamana, ledida la hemna.

Verav chisda amar: echad ze veechad ze – en soklin. veazda rav chisda letameh, deamar rav chisda: "beni ze ben tesha shanim veyom echad", "bitti zo bat shalosh shanim veyom echad" – neeman lekorban, aval lo lemakkot velo laonashin.
Tanya kevoteh derav chisda: "beni ze ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad" "bitti zo bat shetem esre shana veyom echad" –
